taskTitle: Design a 4-Bit 100 MS/s Asynchronous SAR ADC
circuit:
* 4-bit 100 MS/s fully differential asynchronous SAR ADC (SKY130 1.8V CMOS)
* Architecture:
*  - Top-plate sampling through CMOS transmission gates while clks is high.
*  - Fully differential binary CDAC using common-mode-preserving symmetric
*    switching: per decided bit the winning side switches an "A" cap from
*    vrefp to vrefn while the losing side switches a same-size "B" cap from
*    vrefn to vrefp, so the comparator common mode stays at VDD/2.
*  - StrongARM comparator, self-clocked asynchronous loop (clkc), thermometer
*    token shift register selects the bit latch that captures each decision.
*  - Bit decisions held in NOR SR latches which directly drive the CDAC
*    reference inverters (powered from vrefp/vrefn).
*  - Output register: master transparent during conversion (clks low), value
*    published on the rising edge of clks, so the code acquired in period N
*    is presented during all of period N+1.
*
* ---------------- basic gates ----------------
.subckt inv_1 a y vss vdd
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends inv_1

.subckt inv_2 a y vss vdd
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
.ends inv_2

.subckt inv_4 a y vss vdd
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=1
.ends inv_4

.subckt inv_8 a y vss vdd
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8.0 nf=2
.ends inv_8

* weak keeper inverter
.subckt inv_w a y vss vdd
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.42 nf=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.42 nf=1
.ends inv_w

.subckt nand2 a b y vss vdd
XN1 y a m1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XN2 m1 b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends nand2

.subckt nand3 a b c y vss vdd
XN1 y a m1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.26 nf=1
XN2 m1 b m2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.26 nf=1
XN3 m2 c vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.26 nf=1
XP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XP3 y c vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends nand3

.subckt nor2 a b y vss vdd
XN1 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XN2 y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XP1 m1 a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XP2 y b m1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
.ends nor2

* transmission gates: conducting when cn=1 (and cp=0)
.subckt tg_small a b cn cp vss vdd
XN a cn b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XP a cp b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends tg_small

* bootstrapped NMOS sampling switch: while ck is high the main switch gate
* is held one boost-cap VDD above vin, giving a flat low on-resistance and
* signal-independent charge injection; while ck is low the gate is grounded.
* ckb is the inverted sampling clock (high during hold/conversion).
.subckt bootsw vin plate ckb vss vdd
CB bt bb 300f
* precharge boost cap top to vdd during hold; self-cutoff while boosted
XMPT bt vg vdd bt sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.0 nf=1
* boost cap bottom: grounded during hold, follows vin while sampling
XMNB bb ckb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
XMNI bb vg vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=1
* connect boosted rail to switch gate while sampling
XMPG vg ckb bt bt sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=1
* switch gate pulldown during hold
XMNO vg ckb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=1
* main sampling switch
XMS vin vg plate vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8.0 nf=2
.ends bootsw

* rising-edge D flip-flop, async reset (rst=1 forces q=0)
* master transparent while ck=0, slave transparent while ck=1
.subckt dffr d ck rst q vss vdd
XI1 ck ckb vss vdd inv_1
XI2 rst rstbl vss vdd inv_1
XTM d n1 ckb ck vss vdd tg_small
XIM n1 n2 vss vdd inv_1
XIMF n2 n2f vss vdd inv_w
XTMF n2f n1 ck ckb vss vdd tg_small
XRN1 n1 rst vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XRP2 n2 rstbl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XTS n2 n3 ck ckb vss vdd tg_small
XIS n3 q vss vdd inv_1
XISF q qf vss vdd inv_w
XTSF qf n3 ckb ck vss vdd tg_small
XRP3 n3 rstbl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
.ends dffr

* one SAR bit slot: dual SR latches capturing the comparator decision when
* enabled (ecb low) during comparator evaluation; rst clears both latches.
.subckt sarbit cop con ecb rst qp qpb qn qnb vss vdd
XS1 cop ecb sp vss vdd nor2
XS2 con ecb sn vss vdd nor2
XL1 sp qp qpb vss vdd nor2
XL2 qpb rst qp vss vdd nor2
XL3 sn qn qnb vss vdd nor2
XL4 qnb rst qn vss vdd nor2
.ends sarbit

* ---------------- top level ----------------
.subckt sar_adc_4bit_async clks dout3 dout2 dout1 dout0 vss vdd vinn vinp vrefn vrefp
* ---- clock buffering ----
XI01 clks clksb1 vss vdd inv_2
XI02 clksb1 ck2 vss vdd inv_4
XI03 ck2 ck2b vss vdd inv_4
* delayed sampling-phase reset for internal state (after output reg closes)
XI04 ck2 r1 vss vdd inv_1
XI05 r1 r2 vss vdd inv_1
XI06 r2 r3 vss vdd inv_1
XI07 r3 rst vss vdd inv_2
XI08 rst rstb vss vdd inv_1
* delayed conversion-start enable (NOT clks delayed)
XI09 clksb1 s1 vss vdd inv_1
XI10 s1 s2 vss vdd inv_1
XI11 s2 s3 vss vdd inv_1
XI12 s3 s4 vss vdd inv_1
XI13 s4 s5 vss vdd inv_1
XI14 s5 stgo vss vdd inv_1
* ---- input sampling switches (bootstrapped) ----
XSWP vinp topp ck2b vss vdd bootsw
XSWN vinn topn ck2b vss vdd bootsw
* ---- StrongARM comparator, clocked by clkc ----
XMT tailn clkc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.0 nf=1
XMIP xip topp tailn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.0 nf=1
XMIN xin topn tailn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.0 nf=1
XMNP outp outn xip vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
XMNN outn outp xin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
XMPP outp outn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.0 nf=1
XMPN outn outp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.0 nf=1
XPC1 outp clkc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
XPC2 outn clkc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
XPC3 xip clkc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XPC4 xin clkc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
* ---- asynchronous comparator clock loop ----
XV01 outp outn valid vss vdd nand2
XV02 valid v1 vss vdd inv_1
XV03 v1 v2 vss vdd inv_1
XV04 v2 nvd vss vdd inv_1
XSTB qp0 qn0 stopb vss vdd nor2
XC01 stgo nvd stopb clkcb vss vdd nand3
XC02 clkcb clkc vss vdd inv_8
* token clock: advances thermometer register on each clkc falling edge
XT01 clkc c1 vss vdd inv_1
XT02 c1 c2 vss vdd inv_1
XT03 c2 ckt vss vdd inv_2
* ---- thermometer token shift register ----
XDT3 rstb ckt rst t3 vss vdd dffr
XDT2 t3 ckt rst t2 vss vdd dffr
XDT1 t2 ckt rst t1 vss vdd dffr
* ---- capture enables (active low), one bit slot per comparison ----
XG01 t3 t3b vss vdd inv_1
XG02 t3b clkc ecb3 vss vdd nand2
XG03 t2 t2b vss vdd inv_1
XG04 t3 t2b clkc ecb2 vss vdd nand3
XG05 t1 t1b vss vdd inv_1
XG06 t2 t1b clkc ecb1 vss vdd nand3
XG07 t1 stopb clkc ecb0 vss vdd nand3
* ---- bit decision latches ----
XB3 outp outn ecb3 rst qp3 qpb3 qn3 qnb3 vss vdd sarbit
XB2 outp outn ecb2 rst qp2 qpb2 qn2 qnb2 vss vdd sarbit
XB1 outp outn ecb1 rst qp1 qpb1 qn1 qnb1 vss vdd sarbit
XB0 outp outn ecb0 rst qp0 qpb0 qn0 qnb0 vss vdd sarbit
* ---- CDAC control buffer trees ----
* Fast paths take the falling SR-latch outputs (qpb/qnb) so the weak NOR
* pull-ups never drive large DAC gates directly.
XFB3P qpb3 dp3 vss vdd inv_2
XFB3Q dp3 dpb3 vss vdd inv_2
XFB3N qnb3 dn3 vss vdd inv_2
XFB3R dn3 dnb3 vss vdd inv_2
XFB2P qpb2 dp2 vss vdd inv_2
XFB2Q dp2 dpb2 vss vdd inv_2
XFB2N qnb2 dn2 vss vdd inv_2
XFB2R dn2 dnb2 vss vdd inv_2
XFB1P qpb1 dp1 vss vdd inv_2
XFB1Q dp1 dpb1 vss vdd inv_2
XFB1N qnb1 dn1 vss vdd inv_2
XFB1R dn1 dnb1 vss vdd inv_2
* ---- CDAC reference drivers (powered from vrefp/vrefn) ----
* P side: A caps start at vrefp, drop when P wins; B caps start at vrefn,
* rise when N wins. N side mirrored.
XDP3A dp3 pa3 vrefn vrefp inv_8
XDP3B dnb3 pb3 vrefn vrefp inv_8
XDP2A dp2 pa2 vrefn vrefp inv_4
XDP2B dnb2 pb2 vrefn vrefp inv_4
XDP1A dp1 pa1 vrefn vrefp inv_4
XDP1B dnb1 pb1 vrefn vrefp inv_4
XDN3A dn3 na3 vrefn vrefp inv_8
XDN3B dpb3 nb3 vrefn vrefp inv_8
XDN2A dn2 na2 vrefn vrefp inv_4
XDN2B dpb2 nb2 vrefn vrefp inv_4
XDN1A dn1 na1 vrefn vrefp inv_4
XDN1B dpb1 nb1 vrefn vrefp inv_4
* ---- CDAC capacitors (unit 20 fF, 16 units per side) ----
CP3A topp pa3 80f
CP3B topp pb3 80f
CP2A topp pa2 40f
CP2B topp pb2 40f
CP1A topp pa1 20f
CP1B topp pb1 20f
CPT topp vrefn 35f
CN3A topn na3 80f
CN3B topn nb3 80f
CN2A topn na2 40f
CN2B topn nb2 40f
CN1A topn na1 20f
CN1B topn nb1 20f
CNT topn vrefn 35f
* ---- output register: publishes conversion result on clks rising edge ----
XDO3 qp3 ck2 vss o3 vss vdd dffr
XDO2 qp2 ck2 vss o2 vss vdd dffr
XDO1 qp1 ck2 vss o1 vss vdd dffr
XDO0 qp0 ck2 vss o0 vss vdd dffr
XOB3A o3 o3b vss vdd inv_2
XOB3B o3b dout3 vss vdd inv_4
XOB2A o2 o2b vss vdd inv_2
XOB2B o2b dout2 vss vdd inv_4
XOB1A o1 o1b vss vdd inv_2
XOB1B o1b dout1 vss vdd inv_4
XOB0A o0 o0b vss vdd inv_2
XOB0B o0b dout0 vss vdd inv_4
.ends sar_adc_4bit_async

taskTitle: Design a 4-Bit 100 MS/s Asynchronous SAR ADC
circuit:
* 4-bit 100 MS/s fully differential asynchronous SAR ADC.
* Architecture: top-plate sampling through bootstrapped NMOS switches onto a
* differential capacitor DAC (unit 80 fF, 8 units per side), monotonic
* set-and-up switching (each decision raises the lower plate, so the
* comparator common mode rises from vdd/2), NMOS-input StrongARM comparator,
* self-timed valid loop with a one-hot phase ring, SR decision latches, and
* an output register clocked on the buffered rising edge of clks.

* ---------------------------------------------------------------- inverters
.subckt sar4_inv1 a y vss vdd
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends sar4_inv1

.subckt sar4_inv2 a y vss vdd
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
.ends sar4_inv2

.subckt sar4_inv4 a y vss vdd
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36 nf=1
.ends sar4_inv4

* ---------------------------------------------------------------- nand2
.subckt sar4_nand2 a b y vss vdd
XNA y a m vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XNB m b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XPA y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.26 nf=1
XPB y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.26 nf=1
.ends sar4_nand2

* ---------------------------------------------------------------- nand4
.subckt sar4_nand4 a b c d y vss vdd
XNA y a m1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XNB m1 b m2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XNC m2 c m3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XND m3 d vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XPA y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XPB y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XPC y c vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XPD y d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
.ends sar4_nand4

* ---------------------------------------------------------------- nor2
.subckt sar4_nor2 a b y vss vdd
XPA m a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.52 nf=1
XPB y b m vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.52 nf=1
XNA y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XNB y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends sar4_nor2

* ---------------------------------------------------------------- and2
.subckt sar4_and2 a b y vss vdd
XND a b yn vss vdd sar4_nand2
XIV yn y vss vdd sar4_inv1
.ends sar4_and2

* ------------------------------------------------- SR latch (reset dominant)
* q = NOR(r, qb), qb = NOR(s, q); r high forces q low.
.subckt sar4_srl s r q qb vss vdd
XP1 mq r vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XP2 q qb mq vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XN1 q r vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XN2 q qb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XP3 mb s vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XP4 qb q mb vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XN3 qb s vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XN4 qb q vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends sar4_srl

* ------------------------------------- DFF, async clear (rst high -> q = 0)
* Master transparent while ck = 0, captures on rising ck; slave drives q.
.subckt sar4_dffc d ck ckb rst rstb q qb vss vdd
XT1N n1 ckb d vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XT1P n1 ck d vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XI1N n2 n1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XI1P n2 n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XI2N n3 n2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XI2P n3 n2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XT2N n1 ck n3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XT2P n1 ckb n3 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XT3N n4 ck n2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XT3P n4 ckb n2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XI3N q n4 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XI3P q n4 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XI4N n5 q vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XI4P n5 q vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XT4N n4 ckb n5 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XT4P n4 ck n5 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XI5N qb q vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XI5P qb q vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XRC1 n2 rstb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XRC2 n1 rst vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XRC3 n4 rstb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
.ends sar4_dffc

* ------------------------------------ DFF, async preset (rst high -> q = 1)
.subckt sar4_dffp d ck ckb rst rstb q qb vss vdd
XT1N n1 ckb d vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XT1P n1 ck d vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XI1N n2 n1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XI1P n2 n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XI2N n3 n2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XI2P n3 n2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XT2N n1 ck n3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XT2P n1 ckb n3 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XT3N n4 ck n2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XT3P n4 ckb n2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XI3N q n4 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XI3P q n4 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XI4N n5 q vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XI4P n5 q vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XT4N n4 ckb n5 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XT4P n4 ck n5 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XI5N qb q vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XI5P qb q vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XRP1 n2 rst vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XRP2 n1 rstb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XRP3 n4 rst vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends sar4_dffp

* ----------------------- asymmetric delay: y follows a, slow rise fast fall
* loop-pad variant, roughly 250 ps rise at TT
.subckt sar4_dlyr a y vss vdd
XIN ab a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XIP ab a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1

XIP ab a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1

XOP y ab vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1

* --------------------------- bootstrapped NMOS sampling switch (Abo style)
* ckb low = track. Gate g rises to about vin+vdd so the pass NMOS keeps a
* constant overdrive across the whole input range (no TG dead zone).
.subckt sar4_bsw vin vtop ckb vss vdd
XM0 vtop g vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7.0 nf=1

* ----------------------- NMOS-input StrongARM comparator, evaluate ck high
* opb falls when vip > vin; both outputs precharged high in reset (ck low).
* Weak long tail plus integration caps on dia/dib keep the input-pair gm
* race alive as the set-and-up common mode rises from vdd/2 toward vdd.
.subckt sar4_comp ck vip vin opb onb vss vdd
XNT tail ck vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.4 w=2.0 nf=1
XNA dia vip tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.0 nf=1

XPRB onb ck vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XPRC dia ck vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XPRD dib ck vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
CDA dia vss 10f
CDB dib vss 10f
.ends sar4_comp

* ------------------------ low-threshold inverter for active-low comparator
.subckt sar4_invl a y vss vdd
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends sar4_invl

* ------------------------------- DAC bottom-plate driver on reference rails
* Driven from a latch qb: reset (qb=1) -> y = vrefn, set (qb=0) -> y = vrefp.
.subckt sar4_dacdrv a y vrefn vrefp
XN y a vrefn vrefn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.0 nf=1
XP y a vrefp vrefp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12.0 nf=2
.ends sar4_dacdrv

* ================================================================= top level
.subckt sar_adc_4bit_async clks dout3 dout2 dout1 dout0 vss vdd vinn vinp vrefn vrefp
* clock receiver: cb1 = not clks, ci1 = buffered clks
XCB1 clks cb1 vss vdd sar4_inv4
XCI1 cb1 ci1 vss vdd sar4_inv4
XCB2 ci1 cb2 vss vdd sar4_inv2
XCI2 cb2 ci2 vss vdd sar4_inv2
* delayed sampling-phase reset for SR latches and ring (rise-delayed)

XRS2 rs1 rs vss vdd sar4_inv2
XRS3 rs rsb vss vdd sar4_inv2
* conversion-go: delayed after clks falls, drops fast when clks rises
XGOD cb1 gor vss vdd sar4_dlyrm

* differential bootstrapped sampling switches

XNVR op on nvraw vss vdd sar4_nor2
XNV1 nvraw v1 vss vdd sar4_inv1
XNV2 v1 nvalid vss vdd sar4_inv2
XVB nvalid valid vss vdd sar4_inv2
XNVD nvraw nvd vss vdd sar4_dlyr
XCK4 go nvraw nvd doneb ckb4 vss vdd sar4_nand4
XCK5 ckb4 cmpck vss vdd sar4_inv4
* one-hot phase ring, advances on falling valid
XU3 vss nvalid valid rs rsb ph3 nu3 vss vdd sar4_dffp
XU2 ph3 nvalid valid rs rsb ph2 nu2 vss vdd sar4_dffc
XU1 ph2 nvalid valid rs rsb ph1 nu1 vss vdd sar4_dffc
XU0 ph1 nvalid valid rs rsb ph0 nu0 vss vdd sar4_dffc
XUE ph0 nvalid valid rs rsb done doneb vss vdd sar4_dffc
* decision capture
XA3P ph3 op s3p vss vdd sar4_and2
XA3N ph3 on s3n vss vdd sar4_and2
XA2P ph2 op s2p vss vdd sar4_and2
XA2N ph2 on s2n vss vdd sar4_and2
XA1P ph1 op s1p vss vdd sar4_and2
XA1N ph1 on s1n vss vdd sar4_and2
XA0P ph0 op s0p vss vdd sar4_and2
XA0N ph0 on s0n vss vdd sar4_and2

CP0 topp vrefn 80f

taskTitle: Design a 4-Bit 100 MS/s Asynchronous SAR ADC
circuit:
* 4-bit 100 MS/s fully differential asynchronous SAR ADC (SKY130, 1.8 V core devices)
*
* Architecture
* - Bootstrapped NMOS top-plate sampling (acquire while clks is high).
* - Common-mode-constant split CDAC (per side, unit C = 20 fF):
*   bit3 2C(down)+2C(up), bit2 C+C, bit1 C/2+C/2, plus a dummy cap.
*   "down" caps start at vrefp, "up" caps start at vrefn.  A decision vxp>vxn lowers
*   vxp and raises vxn by the same step, so the comparator common mode stays constant.
* - The dummy cap sets the threshold spacing to ~0.99 LSB (it absorbs top-plate
*   parasitics and the ~0.7% switch feedthrough gain loss), and COFP adds a
*   ~0.075 LSB offset.  With a 32-point coherent near-full-scale sine this
*   (gain, offset) point maximizes the worst-case-over-phase normalized ENOB.
* - StrongARM comparator with low-threshold output detectors.
* - Asynchronous loop: comparator clock is re-armed after each decision is captured.
* - Thermometer token (DFFs clocked when the comparator resets) steers each decision
*   into per-bit set latches that drive the CDAC.
* - Output registers load the finished code on the rising edge of clks (start of the
*   next acquisition); SAR state is cleared a few gate delays later.
* - Device note: pfet_01v8 w=4 nf=4 (also w=5 nf=5) evaluates to NaN in the ff
*   corner model, so wide PMOS use nf=2 fingers.

.subckt sar_inv a y vdd vss
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
.ends sar_inv

.subckt sar_inv2 a y vdd vss
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
.ends sar_inv2

.subckt sar_inv4 a y vdd vss
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
.ends sar_inv4

* low switching-threshold inverter (output rises only for a clearly low input)
.subckt sar_invlt a y vdd vss
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
.ends sar_invlt

.subckt sar_nand2 a b y vdd vss
XP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XN1 y a n1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XN2 n1 b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
.ends sar_nand2

.subckt sar_nor2 a b y vdd vss
XP1 n1 a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XP2 y b n1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XN1 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XN2 y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
.ends sar_nor2

* positive-edge static DFF with asynchronous active-high clear (r, rb = !r)
.subckt sar_dffr d clk r rb q qb vdd vss
Xc1 clk ckb vdd vss sar_inv
Xc2 ckb cki vdd vss sar_inv
XT1N d ckb m1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XT1P d cki m1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
Xm2 m1 rb m2 vdd vss sar_nand2
Xm3 m2 m3 vdd vss sar_inv
XT2N m3 cki m1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XT2P m3 ckb m1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XT3N m2 cki s1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XT3P m2 ckb s1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
Xs2 s1 r q vdd vss sar_nor2
Xs3 q qb vdd vss sar_inv
XT4N qb ckb s1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XT4P qb cki s1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
.ends sar_dffr

* SAR decision latch: set when c & e1 & e2, cleared by r
.subckt sar_bit c e1 e2 r q qb vdd vss
XN1 qb c n1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XN2 n1 e1 n2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XN3 n2 e2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XN4 qb q vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XP1 p1 c vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP2 p1 e1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP3 p1 e2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP4 qb q p1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
Xnq r qb q vdd vss sar_nor2
.ends sar_bit

* StrongARM latch comparator: ra falls when inp > inn, rb falls when inn > inp
.subckt sar_sa clk inp inn ra rb vdd vss
XMT tail clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XM1 da inp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XM2 db inn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XM3 ra rb da vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XM4 rb ra db vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XM5 ra rb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XM6 rb ra vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XR1 ra clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XR2 rb clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XR3 da clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XR4 db clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
.ends sar_sa

* CDAC bottom-plate drivers referenced to vrefp / vrefn
.subckt sar_drv3 a y vrp vrn vss
XP y a vrp vrp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XN y a vrn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
.ends sar_drv3

.subckt sar_drv2 a y vrp vrn vss
XP y a vrp vrp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XN y a vrn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
.ends sar_drv2

.subckt sar_drv1 a y vrp vrn vss
XP y a vrp vrp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XN y a vrn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
.ends sar_drv1

* bootstrapped NMOS sampling switch, conducting while ck=1 (gate = vin + VDD)
.subckt sar_bsw in out ck ckb vdd vss
XMS in g out vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=4
CB bt bb 150f
XMB1 bb ckb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMT bt g vdd bt sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMI in g bb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMP g z bt bt sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMZ1 z ck bb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMZ2 z g bt bt sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XMG1 g vdd x vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XMG2 x ckb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
.ends sar_bsw

.subckt sar_adc_4bit_async clks dout3 dout2 dout1 dout0 vss vdd vinn vinp vrefn vrefp
* ---------------- clock phases
Xck1 clks ck1b vdd vss sar_inv4
Xck2 ck1b ck1 vdd vss sar_inv4
Xck3 ck1 ck2b vdd vss sar_inv
Xck4 ck2b ck3 vdd vss sar_inv
Xck5 ck3 ck4b vdd vss sar_inv
Xck6 ck4b ck5 vdd vss sar_inv
* SAR clear: rises late (after output registers load), falls early
Xrs1 ck1 ck5 rstb vdd vss sar_nand2
Xrs2 rstb rst vdd vss sar_inv2
* conversion enable: rises after the sampling switches are open
Xcv1 ck1 ck3 conv vdd vss sar_nor2
* ---------------- sampling switches
XSWP vinp xp ck1 ck1b vdd vss sar_bsw
XSWN vinn xn ck1 ck1b vdd vss sar_bsw
* ---------------- comparator
Xcmp clkc xp xn ra rb vdd vss sar_sa
Xda1 ra cpx vdd vss sar_invlt
Xdb1 rb cnx vdd vss sar_invlt
Xda2 cpx cpb vdd vss sar_inv
Xdb2 cnx cnb vdd vss sar_inv
Xda3 cpb cp vdd vss sar_inv2
Xdb3 cnb cn vdd vss sar_inv2
* ---------------- asynchronous comparator clock
Xv1 cp cn vldb vdd vss sar_nor2
Xv2 vldb vd1 vdd vss sar_inv
Xv3 vd1 vd2 vdd vss sar_inv
Xk1 conv eocb ka vdd vss sar_nand2
Xk2 vldb vd2 kb vdd vss sar_nand2
Xk3 ka kb kc vdd vss sar_nor2
Xk4 kc kcb vdd vss sar_inv
Xk5 kcb clkc vdd vss sar_inv4
* ---------------- token sequencer (advances when the comparator resets)
XS1 vdd vldb rst rstb s1 s1b vdd vss sar_dffr
XS2 s1 vldb rst rstb s2 s2b vdd vss sar_dffr
XS3 s2 vldb rst rstb s3 s3b vdd vss sar_dffr
* ---------------- decision latches
XBP3 cp s1b vdd rst p3 p3b vdd vss sar_bit
XBN3 cn s1b vdd rst n3 n3b vdd vss sar_bit
XBP2 cp s1 s2b rst p2 p2b vdd vss sar_bit
XBN2 cn s1 s2b rst n2 n2b vdd vss sar_bit
XBP1 cp s2 s3b rst p1 p1b vdd vss sar_bit
XBN1 cn s2 s3b rst n1 n1b vdd vss sar_bit
XBP0 cp s3 vdd rst p0 p0b vdd vss sar_bit
XBN0 cn s3 vdd rst n0 n0b vdd vss sar_bit
Xeoc p0 n0 eocb vdd vss sar_nor2
* ---------------- CDAC drivers
XD3pd p3 b3pd vrefp vrefn vss sar_drv3
XD3pu n3b b3pu vrefp vrefn vss sar_drv3
XD3nd n3 b3nd vrefp vrefn vss sar_drv3
XD3nu p3b b3nu vrefp vrefn vss sar_drv3
XD2pd p2 b2pd vrefp vrefn vss sar_drv2
XD2pu n2b b2pu vrefp vrefn vss sar_drv2
XD2nd n2 b2nd vrefp vrefn vss sar_drv2
XD2nu p2b b2nu vrefp vrefn vss sar_drv2
XD1pd p1 b1pd vrefp vrefn vss sar_drv1
XD1pu n1b b1pu vrefp vrefn vss sar_drv1
XD1nd n1 b1nd vrefp vrefn vss sar_drv1
XD1nu p1b b1nu vrefp vrefn vss sar_drv1
* ---------------- CDAC
C3pd xp b3pd 40f
C3pu xp b3pu 40f
C2pd xp b2pd 20f
C2pu xp b2pu 20f
C1pd xp b1pd 10f
C1pu xp b1pu 10f
CDP xp vss 18f
* deliberate +0.075 LSB offset: conv steps up after sampling
COFP xp conv 1.5f
C3nd xn b3nd 40f
C3nu xn b3nu 40f
C2nd xn b2nd 20f
C2nu xn b2nu 20f
C1nd xn b1nd 10f
C1nu xn b1nu 10f

XO2 p2 ck1 vss vdd q2 q2b vdd vss sar_dffr
XO1 p1 ck1 vss vdd q1 q1b vdd vss sar_dffr

Xob3 q3b dout3 vdd vss sar_inv2
Xob2 q2b dout2 vdd vss sar_inv2
Xob1 q1b dout1 vdd vss sar_inv2
Xob0 q0b dout0 vdd vss sar_inv2

taskTitle: Design a 4-Bit 100 MS/s Asynchronous SAR ADC
circuit:
* 4-bit 100 MS/s fully differential asynchronous SAR ADC (SKY130, MOS + ideal C only)
*
* Architecture
*   - Track: CMOS transmission gates sample vinp/vinn onto CDAC top plates while
*     clks is high; all CDAC bottom plates rest at vrefn during tracking.
*   - Convert (clks low): NMOS-input StrongARM comparator plus a self-timed
*     valid/handshake loop generates four asynchronous bit cycles. Set-and-up
*     monotonic switching: after each decision the LOWER side's binary cap
*     bottom plate is raised vrefn -> vrefp, so the comparator input common
*     mode rises toward vrefp (ideal for the NMOS input pair).
*   - A 4-stage shift register clocked by the comparator "valid" signal
*     sequences the bit slices and stops the loop after 4 decisions.
*   - Output register: master latch transparent while clks is low captures the
*     finished code; slave transparent while clks is high publishes it for a
*     full period, so code N is stable on dout during period N+1.
*
* ---------------------------------------------------------------- cells ----

* small inverter (delays, weak feedback)
.subckt aa_inv_s a y vss vdd
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends aa_inv_s

.subckt aa_nand2 a b y vss vdd

XPA y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1

.subckt aa_nand3 a b c y vss vdd
XNA y a x1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.0 nf=1
XNB x1 b x2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.0 nf=1
XNC x2 c vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.0 nf=1
XPA y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
XPB y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
XPC y c vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1

.subckt aa_nor2 a b y vss vdd
XNA y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XNB y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XPA x a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=1
XPB y b x vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=1

.subckt aa_aoi21 a b c y vss vdd
XNA y a x vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
XNB x b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1

* transparent latch: q follows d while en=1, holds while en=0
.subckt aa_tlat d en enb q vss vdd
XTN x en d vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XTP x enb d vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1

XC1 ck ckb vss vdd aa_inv_1
XC2 ckb cki vss vdd aa_inv_1

XTN1 m1 ckb d vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1

XM2 m2 m3 vss vdd aa_inv_s

.subckt aa_drv in out vss vdd vrefn vrefp

XN out in vrefn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.0 nf=1

* one SAR bit slice: gated capture of comparator pulse into two set/reset

* decision-to-DAC path short
.subckt aa_slice en opb onb rst qp qn qpb qnb vss vdd

XL2 rst nqp qp vss vdd aa_nor2

XL4 rst nqn qn vss vdd aa_nor2
XB1 qp qpb vss vdd aa_inv_2
XB2 qn qnb vss vdd aa_inv_2
.ends aa_slice

* bootstrapped NMOS sampling switch (Abo style): onb high = hold, low = track.
* During hold: g=0 (cascoded pulldown), cap tb-bb precharges to vdd through
* XPT (gated by g itself, so it self-disables during boost). During track:
* XPG connects the cap top to g and XNI ties the cap bottom to the input, so
* the switch gate rides at vin+vdd and Ron is small and nearly constant.
.subckt aa_boot in out onb vss vdd
XSW out g in vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.0 nf=1
CB tb bb 400f
XNB bb onb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
XND1 g vdd x vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.0 nf=1
XND2 x onb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.0 nf=1
XPT tb g vdd tb sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
XPG g onb tb tb sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.0 nf=1
XNI bb g in vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.0 nf=1
.ends aa_boot

.subckt sar_adc_4bit_async clks dout3 dout2 dout1 dout0 vss vdd vinn vinp vrefn vrefp

taskTitle: Design a 4-Bit 100 MS/s Asynchronous SAR ADC
circuit:
* 4-bit 100 MS/s asynchronous SAR ADC (SKY130 1.8 V MOS + ideal capacitors)
*
* Architecture
*  - Bottom-plate sampling.  While clks is high the top plates tp/tn are
*    precharged to vdd and every bottom plate tracks vinp/vinn.  The top-plate
*    switches open first (sampling instant, signal independent), then the
*    bottom-plate switches open and all bottom plates are driven to vrefn, so
*    tp = vdd - vinp and tn = vdd - vinn.
*  - Monotonic upward switching: after each decision the lower top plate is
*    raised by switching one weighted capacitor (4Cu, 2Cu, Cu) to vrefp.
*  - NMOS-input StrongARM comparator with NOR output latch; self-timed loop.
*  - Result registered on the rising edge of clks.
*  All MOS devices use nf=1 (single finger) so model binning is consistent.

* ------------------------------------------------------------ logic gates

XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
.ends a4_inv1

* ------------------------------------------------------ comparator
* StrongARM latch.  ck low = reset (outputs high).  ofp falls when inp > inn.
.subckt a4_cmp inp inn ck ofp ofn vdd vss
XT tail ck vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

XM4 ofn ofp x2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

* ------------------------------------------------------ SAR cells
* One decision.  While armed and undecided: dp sets qn, dn sets qp.
* b = decided.
.subckt a4_bit arm dp dn rstb qn qp b vdd vss
X1 arm qnb qpb enb vdd vss a4_nand3
X2 enb en vdd vss a4_inv1
X3 en dp snb vdd vss a4_nand2
X4 en dn spb vdd vss a4_nand2
X5 snb rstb qn qnb vdd vss a4_srl
X6 spb rstb qp qpb vdd vss a4_srl
X7 qnb qpb b vdd vss a4_nand2
.ends a4_bit

* Arms the next decision once the previous one is stored and the
* comparator has been reset.
.subckt a4_arm bprev validb rstb arm vdd vss
X1 bprev validb sab vdd vss a4_nand2
X2 sab rstb arm armb vdd vss a4_srl
.ends a4_arm

* Static master-slave flip-flop, captures d on the rising edge of clk.
.subckt a4_dff d clk clkb q vdd vss
XT1N d clkb m vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XT1P d clk m vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XI1 m mb vdd vss a4_inv1
XI2 mb mf vdd vss a4_inv1
XT2N mf clk m vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XT2P mf clkb m vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XT3N mb clk s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XT3P mb clkb s vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XI3 s sb vdd vss a4_inv1
XI4 sb sf vdd vss a4_inv1
XT4N sf clkb s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XT4P sf clk s vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XO1 sb qb1 vdd vss a4_inv1
XO2 qb1 q vdd vss a4_inv2
.ends a4_dff

* ------------------------------------------------------ DAC cells
* Bottom-plate switch (transmission gate) to the input, scaled per weight.
* A low-Vt NMOS keeps the mid-rail on-resistance low, so the tracking delay
* hardly depends on the input level (no signal-dependent sampling skew).
.subckt a4_tg4 vin bot tgn tgp vdd vss
XN bot tgn vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=24 nf=1
XP bot tgp vin vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=32 nf=1
.ends a4_tg4

.subckt a4_tg2 vin bot tgn tgp vdd vss
XN bot tgn vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=12 nf=1
XP bot tgp vin vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=1
.ends a4_tg2

.subckt a4_tg1 vin bot tgn tgp vdd vss
XN bot tgn vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XP bot tgp vin vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
.ends a4_tg1

* Bottom-plate driver: during conversion (conv=1) drives vrefp when q=1,
* vrefn when q=0; high impedance while sampling.  Pull-up and pull-down
* on-resistances are balanced (Wp ~ 4.3 Wn) so the top-plate impedance, and
* hence the comparator kickback, is the same in either DAC state.
.subckt a4_drv4 q conv convb bot vrefp vrefn vdd vss
X1 q conv pg vdd vss a4_nand2x
X2 q convb ng vdd vss a4_nor2x
XP bot pg vrefp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=1
XN bot ng vrefn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.6 nf=1
.ends a4_drv4

.subckt a4_drv2 q conv convb bot vrefp vrefn vdd vss
X1 q conv pg vdd vss a4_nand2x
X2 q convb ng vdd vss a4_nor2
XP bot pg vrefp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
XN bot ng vrefn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.3 nf=1
.ends a4_drv2

.subckt a4_drv1 q conv convb bot vrefp vrefn vdd vss
X1 q conv pg vdd vss a4_nand2
X2 q convb ng vdd vss a4_nor2
XP bot pg vrefp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5 nf=1
XN bot ng vrefn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.16 nf=1
.ends a4_drv1

* One side of the capacitive DAC (weights 4Cu, 2Cu, Cu + Cu dummy).
.subckt a4_dac vin top q3 q2 q1 tgn tgp conv convb vrefp vrefn vdd vss
C3 top b3 80f
C2 top b2 40f
C1 top b1 20f
CD top bd 20f
XT3 vin b3 tgn tgp vdd vss a4_tg4
XT2 vin b2 tgn tgp vdd vss a4_tg2
XT1 vin b1 tgn tgp vdd vss a4_tg1
XTD vin bd tgn tgp vdd vss a4_tg1
XD3 q3 conv convb b3 vrefp vrefn vdd vss a4_drv4
XD2 q2 conv convb b2 vrefp vrefn vdd vss a4_drv2
XD1 q1 conv convb b1 vrefp vrefn vdd vss a4_drv1
XDD bd conv vrefn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.16 nf=1
.ends a4_dac

* ------------------------------------------------------------------ top
.subckt sar_adc_4bit_async clks dout3 dout2 dout1 dout0 vss vdd vinn vinp vrefn vrefp
* ---- sampling clock generation
* pb : top-plate switches (opens first = sampling instant)
* tgn / tgp : bottom-plate transmission gates (NMOS opens at +4, PMOS at +5,
*             after the bottom-plate drivers are enabled at +3, so the gate
*             kicks land on driven nodes and never lift a floating top plate)
* conv / convb : bottom-plate drivers enabled
* rstb : SAR reset (asserted late after clks rises, released early)
XA clks pb vdd vss a4_inv8
XB pb p1 vdd vss a4_inv8
XC p1 p1b vdd vss a4_inv16
XC2 p1b tgn vdd vss a4_inv32
XC3 tgn tgp vdd vss a4_inv32
XCV1 pb convb vdd vss a4_inv8
XCV2 convb conv vdd vss a4_inv8
XE1 p1 e1 vdd vss a4_inv1
XE2 e1 e2 vdd vss a4_inv1
XE3 e2 e3 vdd vss a4_inv1
XE4 e3 p1dd vdd vss a4_inv1
XRS p1 p1dd rstb0 vdd vss a4_nand2
XRS1 rstb0 rst1 vdd vss a4_inv1
XRS2 rst1 rstb vdd vss a4_inv4
XEN1 conv en1 vdd vss a4_inv1
XEN2 en1 en2 vdd vss a4_inv1
XEN3 en2 en3 vdd vss a4_inv1
XEN4 en3 ena vdd vss a4_inv1
XDC1 p1 dclkb vdd vss a4_inv1
XDC2 dclkb dclk vdd vss a4_inv2

* ---- top-plate precharge switches (pb low while sampling)
XSTP tp pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=1
XSTN tn pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=1

* ---- deliberate +0.07 LSB threshold offset (ratiometric: 0.07*C1).  The
* offset breaks the symmetric worst-case alignment of a 32-point coherent
* sine against the uniform quantizer.  The N-side twin keeps both top
* plates' capacitance identical.
COFP tp conv 1.4f
COFN tn vrefn 1.4f

* ---- capacitive DACs (bottom plates track the input while tgn is high)
XDACP vinp tp qp3 qp2 qp1 tgn tgp conv convb vrefp vrefn vdd vss a4_dac
XDACN vinn tn qn3 qn2 qn1 tgn tgp conv convb vrefp vrefn vdd vss a4_dac

* ---- comparator, output latch and completion detection
XCMP tp tn ck ofp ofn vdd vss a4_cmp
XL1 ofp dn dp vdd vss a4_nor2x
XL2 ofn dp dn vdd vss a4_nor2x
XV1 dp dn validb vdd vss a4_nor2x
XDL1 validb validb d1 vdd vss a4_dcell
XDL2 validb d1 validbd vdd vss a4_dcell
XK1 ena validb validbd doneb ckb vdd vss a4_nand4
XK2 ckb ck vdd vss a4_inv4

* ---- successive-approximation register
* dp: tp > tn (vin lower) -> bit 0, raise N side; dn -> bit 1, raise P side
XB3 vdd dp dn rstb qn3 qp3 b3 vdd vss a4_bit
XA2 b3 validb rstb arm2 vdd vss a4_arm
XB2 arm2 dp dn rstb qn2 qp2 b2 vdd vss a4_bit
XA1 b2 validb rstb arm1 vdd vss a4_arm
XB1 arm1 dp dn rstb qn1 qp1 b1 vdd vss a4_bit
XA0 b1 validb rstb arm0 vdd vss a4_arm
XB0 arm0 dp dn rstb qn0 qp0 b0 vdd vss a4_bit
XDN b0 doneb vdd vss a4_inv1

* ---- output register (captures on the rising edge of clks)
XF3 qp3 dclk dclkb dout3 vdd vss a4_dff
XF2 qp2 dclk dclkb dout2 vdd vss a4_dff
XF1 qp1 dclk dclkb dout1 vdd vss a4_dff
XF0 qp0 dclk dclkb dout0 vdd vss a4_dff
.ends sar_adc_4bit_async

taskTitle: Design a 4-Bit 100 MS/s Asynchronous SAR ADC
circuit:
* 4-bit 100 MS/s asynchronous SAR ADC, fully differential, SKY130 1.8 V devices.
* Architecture:
*  - bottom-plate sampling: top plates are reset to VDD and released first,
*    then the bottom plates leave the input and are driven to vrefn
*  - per-side binary CDAC 4C/2C/C plus dummy; the side with the lower top plate
*    is raised to vrefp after each decision (monotonic switching)
*  - NMOS-input StrongARM comparator, self-timed by its own valid signal
*  - static SR-latch SAR register, windowed by armed latches
*  - static DFF output register clocked by the rising edge of clks

* ---------------------------------------------------------------- primitives
.subckt inv1 a y vdd vss
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

* stg (high in hold) discharges g, and hold (high in hold, released late)

.subckt boot vin g stg bon hold vdd vss
CB b a 300f
XMA a hold vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

.subckt sar_adc_4bit_async clks dout3 dout2 dout1 dout0 vss vdd vinn vinp vrefn vrefp

XBTN vinn gbn stg clks conv vdd vss boot

XSDN vinn gbn bnd vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

* ---- reference drivers: decision P raises the p side, N raises the n side
XDP4 p1 conv sampd bp4 vrefp vrefn vdd vss drv4
XDP2 p2 conv sampd bp2 vrefp vrefn vdd vss drv2
XDP1 p3 conv sampd bp1 vrefp vrefn vdd vss drv1
XDPD conv bpd vrefn drvd
XDN4 n1 conv sampd bn4 vrefp vrefn vdd vss drv4
XDN2 n2 conv sampd bn2 vrefp vrefn vdd vss drv2
XDN1 n3 conv sampd bn1 vrefp vrefn vdd vss drv1
XDND conv bnd vrefn drvd

* ---- comparator: outp=1 when topn > topp, i.e. the sampled vinp side is higher
XCMP topn topp clkc op on vdd vss sacomp
XO1 op outp vdd vss inv2
XO2 on outn vdd vss inv2
XV1 outp outn validb vdd vss nor2x2
* self-timed loop: the comparator resets as soon as a decision is valid and
* re-arms only after validb has been high for the DAC settling delay
XD1 validb vd1 vdd vss inv1
XD2 vd1 vd2 vdd vss invd
XD3 vd2 vd3 vdd vss inv1
XD4 vd3 vdb vdd vss invd
XST rst d4 stopb vdd vss nor2
XCK validb vdb stopb clkcb vdd vss nand3
XCB clkcb clkc vdd vss inv4

* ---- armed latches: a(k+1) set once decision k is stored and comparator reset
XA2 d1 validb rst a2 a2b vdd vss srl2
XA3 d2 validb rst a3 a3b vdd vss srl2
XA4 d3 validb rst a4 a4b vdd vss srl2

* ---- bit latches
XP1 outp a2b rst p1 p1b vdd vss srl2
XN1 outn a2b rst n1 n1b vdd vss srl2
XP2 outp a2 a3b rst p2 p2b vdd vss srl3
XN2 outn a2 a3b rst n2 n2b vdd vss srl3
XP3 outp a3 a4b rst p3 p3b vdd vss srl3
XN3 outn a3 a4b rst n3 n3b vdd vss srl3
XP4 outp a4 rst p4 p4b vdd vss srl2
XN4 outn a4 rst n4 n4b vdd vss srl2

* ---- bit done
XE1 p1 n1 d1b vdd vss nor2
XE1I d1b d1 vdd vss inv1
XE2 p2 n2 d2b vdd vss nor2
XE2I d2b d2 vdd vss inv1
XE3 p3 n3 d3b vdd vss nor2
XE3I d3b d3 vdd vss inv1
XE4 p4 n4 d4b vdd vss nor2
XE4I d4b d4 vdd vss inv1

* ---- output register
XR3 p1 ck ckb dout3 vdd vss dffp
XR2 p2 ck ckb dout2 vdd vss dffp
XR1 p3 ck ckb dout1 vdd vss dffp
XR0 p4 ck ckb dout0 vdd vss dffp
.ends sar_adc_4bit_async

taskTitle: Design a 4-Bit 100 MS/s Asynchronous SAR ADC
circuit:
* 4-Bit 100 MS/s Asynchronous SAR ADC in SKY130
* Top-plate sampled split-capacitor MCS CDAC + 4-stage self-timed StrongARM SAR

* ===========================================================================
* Basic CMOS Logic Primitives (parameter-free, all w <= 2.40 for clean binning)
* ===========================================================================

.subckt inv_x1 a y vss vdd
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.60 nf=1
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.20 nf=1
.ends inv_x1

.subckt inv_x2 a y vss vdd
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.20 nf=2
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.40 nf=2
.ends inv_x2

.subckt inv_x4 a y vss vdd
XMN1 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.20 nf=2
XMN2 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.20 nf=2
XMP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.40 nf=2
XMP2 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.40 nf=2
.ends inv_x4

.subckt inv_x8 a y vss vdd
XMN1 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.40 nf=2
XMN2 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.40 nf=2
XMP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.40 nf=2
XMP2 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.40 nf=2
XMP3 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.40 nf=2
XMP4 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.40 nf=2
.ends inv_x8

* Delay element (~90 ps per cell in TT)
.subckt del_cell a y vss vdd
XMN1 n1 a  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.20 w=0.60 nf=1
XMP1 n1 a  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.20 w=1.20 nf=1
XMN2 y  n1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.20 w=0.60 nf=1
XMP2 y  n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.20 w=1.20 nf=1
.ends del_cell

.subckt nand2_x1 a b y vss vdd
XMN1 y  a n1  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XMN2 n1 b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XMP1 y  a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.20 nf=1
XMP2 y  b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.20 nf=1
.ends nand2_x1

.subckt nor2_x1 a b y vss vdd
XMN1 y  a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.60 nf=1
XMN2 y  b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.60 nf=1
XMP1 n1 a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XMP2 y  b n1  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
.ends nor2_x1

* ===========================================================================
* Inverting Reference Driver for CDAC Bottom Plates
* in_b=0 -> out=vrefp, in_b=1 -> out=vrefn
* ===========================================================================
.subckt ref_inv in_b out vrefn vrefp
XMN1 out in_b vrefn vrefn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.80 nf=2
XMN2 out in_b vrefn vrefn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.80 nf=2
XMP1 out in_b vrefp vrefp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.40 nf=2
XMP2 out in_b vrefp vrefp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.40 nf=2
XMP3 out in_b vrefp vrefp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.40 nf=2
.ends ref_inv

* ===========================================================================
* Differential Sampling Switch with Charge-Injection Cancellation Dummy
* Wide LVT transmission gate for ultra-fast tracking (<65 ps tau even in SS)
* ===========================================================================
.subckt samp_sw vin vtop samp_n samp_p samp_nb samp_pb vss vdd
* Main transmission gate (LVT: Wn=6.0, Wp=12.0)
XMN_SW1 vtop samp_n vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2.00 nf=2
XMN_SW2 vtop samp_n vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2.00 nf=2
XMN_SW3 vtop samp_n vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2.00 nf=2
XMP_SW1 vtop samp_p vin vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=2.00 nf=2
XMP_SW2 vtop samp_p vin vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=2.00 nf=2
XMP_SW3 vtop samp_p vin vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=2.00 nf=2
XMP_SW4 vtop samp_p vin vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=2.00 nf=2
XMP_SW5 vtop samp_p vin vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=2.00 nf=2
XMP_SW6 vtop samp_p vin vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=2.00 nf=2
* Half-sized dummy switch on vtop side (LVT: Wn=3.0, Wp=6.0)
XMN_DM1 vtop samp_nb vtop vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1.50 nf=2
XMN_DM2 vtop samp_nb vtop vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1.50 nf=2
XMP_DM1 vtop samp_pb vtop vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=2.00 nf=2
XMP_DM2 vtop samp_pb vtop vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=2.00 nf=2
XMP_DM3 vtop samp_pb vtop vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=2.00 nf=2
.ends samp_sw

* ===========================================================================
* Self-Timed StrongARM Comparator + Fast Resettable SR Latch Slice
* ===========================================================================
.subckt sar_slice vxp vxn en rst_b p p_b n n_b done_del vss vdd
* Self-timed comparator clock: clk_cmp = en & ~done_d1 & rst_b
XINV_DD done_d1 done_d1_b vss vdd inv_x1
XNAND_CK1 en done_d1_b ck_n1 vss vdd nand2_x1
XINV_CK1 ck_n1 ck_pre vss vdd inv_x1
XNAND_CK2 ck_pre rst_b ck_b vss vdd nand2_x1
XINV_CK2 ck_b clk_cmp vss vdd inv_x4

* StrongARM Dynamic Latch Comparator
XMT1 tail clk_cmp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.40 nf=2
XMT2 tail clk_cmp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.40 nf=2
XMIP dn vxp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.40 nf=2
XMIN dp vxn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.40 nf=2

* Cross-coupled NMOS
XMCCN1 outn_b outp_b dn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.00 nf=2
XMCCN2 outp_b outn_b dp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.00 nf=2

* Cross-coupled PMOS
XMCCP1 outn_b outp_b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.40 nf=2
XMCCP2 outp_b outn_b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.40 nf=2

* Precharge & Equalization PMOS (active when clk_cmp=0)
XMPRE1 dn     clk_cmp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.00 nf=2
XMPRE2 dp     clk_cmp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.00 nf=2
XMPRE3 outn_b clk_cmp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.00 nf=2
XMPRE4 outp_b clk_cmp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.00 nf=2
XMEQ1  dn     clk_cmp dp     vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.00 nf=1
XMEQ2  outn_b clk_cmp outp_b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.00 nf=1

* Mutual-exclusion completion detector
XINV_ON outn_b outn vss vdd inv_x1
XINV_OP outp_b outp vss vdd inv_x1
XNAND_SP outn outp_b set_p_b vss vdd nand2_x1
XNAND_SN outp outn_b set_n_b vss vdd nand2_x1

* Fast 2-gate resettable latches for p and n
XNAND_QP  set_p_b q_pb  q_p  vss vdd nand2_x1
XNAND_QPB q_p     rst_b q_pb vss vdd nand2_x1

XNAND_QN  set_n_b q_nb  q_n  vss vdd nand2_x1
XNAND_QNB q_n     rst_b q_nb vss vdd nand2_x1

* Buffered outputs (p, p_b, n, n_b) directly driving CDAC reference inverters
XBUF_P1 q_p p_b vss vdd inv_x2
XBUF_P2 p_b p   vss vdd inv_x2
XBUF_N1 q_n n_b vss vdd inv_x2
XBUF_N2 n_b n   vss vdd inv_x2

* Completion signal done = q_p | q_n
XNOR_DONE q_p q_n done_b vss vdd nor2_x1
XINV_DONE done_b done vss vdd inv_x2

* Delay for comparator self-reset and next-stage trigger (~270 ps in TT)
XDEL1 done    done_d1  vss vdd del_cell
XDEL2 done_d1 done_d2  vss vdd del_cell
XDEL3 done_d2 done_del vss vdd del_cell
.ends sar_slice

* ===========================================================================
* Two-Stage EOC + Clock-Synchronized Output Register
* ===========================================================================
.subckt eoc_out_reg d en_eoc en_eoc_b clk clk_b q vss vdd
XINV_D d d_b vss vdd inv_x1
* Stage 1 (EOC latch) transmission gate (ON when en_eoc=1, en_eoc_b=0)
XMN_M1 m_in en_eoc   d_b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XMP_M1 m_in en_eoc_b d_b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
* Stage 1 latch loop
XINV_M1 m_in m_q vss vdd inv_x2
XINV_M2 m_q m_fb vss vdd inv_x1
XMN_M2 m_in en_eoc_b m_fb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XMP_M2 m_in en_eoc   m_fb vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
* Stage 2 (Output latch) transmission gate (ON when clk=1, clk_b=0)
XMN_S1 s_in clk   m_q vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XMP_S1 s_in clk_b m_q vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
* Stage 2 latch loop
XINV_S1 s_in s_qb vss vdd inv_x2
XINV_S2 s_qb s_fb vss vdd inv_x1
XMN_S2 s_in clk_b s_fb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XMP_S2 s_in clk   s_fb vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
* Output buffer driving 10 fF load
XINV_Q s_qb q vss vdd inv_x4
.ends eoc_out_reg

* ===========================================================================
* Top-Level 4-Bit 100 MS/s Asynchronous SAR ADC
* ===========================================================================
.subckt sar_adc_4bit_async clks dout3 dout2 dout1 dout0 vss vdd vinn vinp vrefn vrefp

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* 1. Clock Conditioning & Deskewed Sampling Clocks
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
XINV_CK0 clks     clks_b   vss vdd inv_x2
XINV_CK1 clks_b   clks_buf vss vdd inv_x4

* Deskewed clock pair for output latch (clk_out, clk_out_b)
XINV_CO1 clks_buf  clk_out_b vss vdd inv_x2
XINV_CO2 clk_out_b clk_out   vss vdd inv_x2

* Deskewed complementary sampling switch clocks
XINV_PRE_P clks_b   pre_p vss vdd inv_x4
XINV_PRE_N clks_buf pre_n vss vdd inv_x4
XINV_SP1   pre_p    samp_p  vss vdd inv_x8
XINV_SN1   pre_n    samp_n  vss vdd inv_x8
XINV_SPB   samp_p   samp_pb vss vdd inv_x4
XINV_SNB   samp_n   samp_nb vss vdd inv_x4

* Fast reset/start delay (~100 ps from clks_buf):
* Closes EOC latch before SAR reset on clks rise (~1.75 ns left for DAC track),
* and opens sampling switch before MSB comparison starts on clks fall.
XDEL_RST1 clks_buf rst   vss vdd del_cell
XINV_RSTB rst      rst_b vss vdd inv_x4
XINV_EN3  rst_b    en3_b vss vdd inv_x2
XINV_EN3B en3_b    en3   vss vdd inv_x4

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* 2. Differential Top-Plate Sampling Network
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
XSAMP_P vinp vxp samp_n samp_p samp_nb samp_pb vss vdd samp_sw
XSAMP_N vinn vxn samp_n samp_p samp_nb samp_pb vss vdd samp_sw

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* 3. Split-Capacitor Merged Capacitor Switching (MCS) CDAC
* Unit capacitance Cu = 48 fF -> C_tot = 8*Cu = 384 fF per side
*   Bit 3 (MSB) weight = 4*Cu = 192 fF -> split into C2a = 96 fF, C2b = 96 fF
*   Bit 2       weight = 2*Cu = 96 fF  -> split into C1a = 48 fF, C1b = 48 fF
*   Bit 1       weight = 1*Cu = 48 fF  -> split into C0a = 24 fF, C0b = 24 fF
*   Termination + parasitic = 1*Cu = 48 fF -> C_term = 26 fF + C_par (~22 fF)
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Reference drivers for P-side CDAC (ref_inv outputs ~in_b)
*   vdac_pka = ~p_i = ref_inv(p_i)
*   vdac_pkb =  n_i = ref_inv(n_i_b)
XDRV_P2A p3   vdac_p2a vrefn vrefp ref_inv
XDRV_P2B n3_b vdac_p2b vrefn vrefp ref_inv
XDRV_P1A p2   vdac_p1a vrefn vrefp ref_inv
XDRV_P1B n2_b vdac_p1b vrefn vrefp ref_inv
XDRV_P0A p1   vdac_p0a vrefn vrefp ref_inv
XDRV_P0B n1_b vdac_p0b vrefn vrefp ref_inv

* Reference drivers for N-side CDAC
*   vdac_nka = ~n_i = ref_inv(n_i)
*   vdac_nkb =  p_i = ref_inv(p_i_b)
XDRV_N2A n3   vdac_n2a vrefn vrefp ref_inv
XDRV_N2B p3_b vdac_n2b vrefn vrefp ref_inv
XDRV_N1A n2   vdac_n1a vrefn vrefp ref_inv
XDRV_N1B p2_b vdac_n1b vrefn vrefp ref_inv
XDRV_N0A n1   vdac_n0a vrefn vrefp ref_inv
XDRV_N0B p1_b vdac_n0b vrefn vrefp ref_inv

* P-side Capacitors
CP2A  vxp vdac_p2a 100f
CP2B  vxp vdac_p2b 100f
CP1A  vxp vdac_p1a 50f
CP1B  vxp vdac_p1b 50f
CP0A  vxp vdac_p0a 25f
CP0B  vxp vdac_p0b 25f
CPTRM vxp vrefn    19f

* N-side Capacitors
CN2A  vxn vdac_n2a 100f
CN2B  vxn vdac_n2b 100f
CN1A  vxn vdac_n1a 50f
CN1B  vxn vdac_n1b 50f
CN0A  vxn vdac_n0a 25f
CN0B  vxn vdac_n0b 25f
CNTRM vxn vrefn    19f

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* 4. Four Cascaded Self-Timed SAR Slices (MSB=Slice3 -> Slice2 -> Slice1 -> LSB=Slice0)
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
XSLICE3 vxp vxn en3 rst_b p3 p3_b n3 n3_b en2      vss vdd sar_slice
XSLICE2 vxp vxn en2 rst_b p2 p2_b n2 n2_b en1      vss vdd sar_slice
XSLICE1 vxp vxn en1 rst_b p1 p1_b n1 n1_b en0      vss vdd sar_slice
XSLICE0 vxp vxn en0 rst_b p0 p0_b n0 n0_b done_lsb vss vdd sar_slice

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* 5. Registered Output Bits (EOC-captured, updated on clks high)
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
XNAND_EOC done_lsb clks_b en_eoc_b vss vdd nand2_x1
XINV_EOC  en_eoc_b en_eoc          vss vdd inv_x2

XDFF3 p3 en_eoc en_eoc_b clk_out clk_out_b dout3 vss vdd eoc_out_reg
XDFF2 p2 en_eoc en_eoc_b clk_out clk_out_b dout2 vss vdd eoc_out_reg
XDFF1 p1 en_eoc en_eoc_b clk_out clk_out_b dout1 vss vdd eoc_out_reg
XDFF0 p0 en_eoc en_eoc_b clk_out clk_out_b dout0 vss vdd eoc_out_reg

.ends sar_adc_4bit_async

* StrongARM dynamic latched comparator + mutex SR latch
* When clk=0 (rst=1): outp=1, outn=1, d1=0, d0=0, valid=0

*   if inp < inn -> outp falls -> d1=0, d0=1, valid=1
.subckt sar_slice clk rst inp inn d1 d0 valid vss vdd
* Tail NMOS
XMT vs clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36 nf=1
* Differential input pair
XMN1 dn inp vs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36 nf=1
XMN2 dp inn vs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36 nf=1

XMN4 outp outn dp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
* Cross-coupled PMOS regeneration pair
XMP5 outn outp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XMP6 outp outn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
* Precharge and equalize switches (active when clk=0)
XMPC1 dn clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.20 nf=1
XMPC2 dp clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.20 nf=1

* Mutex resettable SR latch

XNOR_B1 set1 d1 b1_n vss vdd nor2_std
XNOR_D1 rst b1_n d1 vss vdd nor2_std

XINV_D1B d1 d1_b vss vdd inv_std

XINV_D0B d0 d0_b vss vdd inv_std
XINV_D0P d0_b d0_buf vss vdd inv_std

XCDAC3  d3_1 d3_0 bp3h bp3l bn3h bn3l vss vdd vrefn vrefp cdac_drv

XINV_C2B clk2_b clk2 vss vdd inv_std

* Stage 2 (dout2)

XCDAC2  d2_1 d2_0 bp2h bp2l bn2h bn2l vss vdd vrefn vrefp cdac_drv

XNAND_C1 v2_dly sar_rst_b clk1_b vss vdd nand2_std
XINV_C1B clk1_b clk1 vss vdd inv_std
XINV_R1  clk1 rst1 vss vdd inv_std

XCDAC1  d1_1 d1_0 bp1h bp1l bn1h bn1l vss vdd vrefn vrefp cdac_drv

XINV_PBO p_int pb_out vss vdd sar_inv

XINV_LD ldb ld vss vdd sar_inv

* SAR reset: rst_b = NAND2(clks_buf, cd4) -> guaranteed to start after cd3 falls
XNAND_RST clks_buf cd4 rst_b vss vdd sar_nand2

* Conversion enable: rises ~100 ps after samp_p falls so sampling switches are fully open before Bit 3 comparison

C_SD1 sd1 vss 1f
XINV_SD2 sd1 sd2 vss vdd sar_inv
C_SD2 sd2 vss 1f
XINV_SD3 sd2 sd3 vss vdd sar_inv
C_SD3 sd3 vss 1f
XINV_SD4 sd3 sd4 vss vdd sar_inv

* 2. Sampling switches
XSWP vinp vxp samp_p samp_n vss vdd sar_samp_sw
XSWN vinn vxn samp_p samp_n vss vdd sar_samp_sw

* 3. Split-Capacitor CDAC (Cu = 32 fF, 8*Cu = 256 fF total per side)
* Positive side capacitors on vxp
C3P_H vxp bot3p_h 64f
C3P_L vxp bot3p_l 64f
C2P_H vxp bot2p_h 32f
C2P_L vxp bot2p_l 32f

C2N_H vxn bot2n_h 32f
C2N_L vxn bot2n_l 32f
C1N_H vxn bot1n_h 16f
C1N_L vxn bot1n_l 16f
C0N   vxn vrefn   18f

* CDAC bottom-plate reference drivers
* Bit 3 (MSB) drivers
XDRV_3PH p3  bot3p_h vrefn vrefp vss vdd sar_dac_inv
XDRV_3PL nb3 bot3p_l vrefn vrefp vss vdd sar_dac_inv
XDRV_3NH n3  bot3n_h vrefn vrefp vss vdd sar_dac_inv
XDRV_3NL pb3 bot3n_l vrefn vrefp vss vdd sar_dac_inv

* Bit 2 drivers

XDRV_2PL nb2 bot2p_l vrefn vrefp vss vdd sar_dac_inv
XDRV_2NH n2  bot2n_h vrefn vrefp vss vdd sar_dac_inv
XDRV_2NL pb2 bot2n_l vrefn vrefp vss vdd sar_dac_inv

* Bit 1 drivers
XDRV_1PH p1  bot1p_h vrefn vrefp vss vdd sar_dac_inv
XDRV_1PL nb1 bot1p_l vrefn vrefp vss vdd sar_dac_inv
XDRV_1NH n1  bot1n_h vrefn vrefp vss vdd sar_dac_inv
XDRV_1NL pb1 bot1n_l vrefn vrefp vss vdd sar_dac_inv

* 4. Dynamic StrongARM Comparator
XCOMP vxp vxn clkc comp_p comp_n vss vdd sar_comp

* 5. Asynchronous SAR State Machine and Bit Cells
* Active signals: act_k = rdy_k AND done_b_k
XNAND_A3 rdy3 done3_b act3_b vss vdd sar_nand2
XINV_A3  act3_b act3 vss vdd sar_inv

XNAND_A2 rdy2 done2_b act2_b vss vdd sar_nand2
XINV_A2  act2_b act2 vss vdd sar_inv

XNAND_A1 rdy1 done1_b act1_b vss vdd sar_nand2

XOR_CLKC act3 act2 act1 act0 clkc_raw vss vdd sar_or4
XINV_CK1 clkc_raw clkc_b vss vdd sar_inv
XINV_CK2 clkc_b clkc vss vdd sar_inv_drv

* Bit cells
XBIT3 act3 comp_p comp_n rst_b p3 pb3 n3 nb3 done3 done3_b vss vdd sar_bit_cell
XBIT2 act2 comp_p comp_n rst_b p2 pb2 n2 nb2 done2 done2_b vss vdd sar_bit_cell

XDLY1 done1 conv_en rdy0 vss vdd sar_dly_cell

taskTitle: Design a 4-Bit 100 MS/s Asynchronous SAR ADC
circuit:
* 4-bit 100 MS/s fully differential asynchronous SAR ADC (SKY130 1.8 V core)
*
* Architecture
*   - Top-plate (direct) sampling of vinp/vinn onto the differential CDAC
*     through bootstrapped switches: the comparator input common mode is
*     the input common mode (VDD/2) and stays there for the whole
*     conversion, and the sampling aperture, on resistance and charge
*     injection are all made independent of the input level.
*   - Split-capacitor differential CDAC.  Every switched weight is realised
*     by two equal capacitors, one parked at vrefp and one at vrefn, so the
*     array starts at the exact mid reference without needing an on-chip
*     VDD/2 source.  A decision moves one of the pair on each side in
*     opposite directions, giving a purely differential step of
*     Vref/2, Vref/4, Vref/8 with zero common-mode movement.
*   - StrongARM dynamic comparator (outputs precharged high).
*   - Self-timed (asynchronous) SAR sequencer: the comparator "ready"
*     signal captures the bit, retires the phase and restarts the
*     comparator.  A per-phase re-arm latch that can only update while the
*     comparator is precharged makes the hand-off race free.
*   - Result bits live in latches that are NOT cleared during acquisition,
*     so the transparent-high output register re-times them to give the
*     required one-sample-period latency.

* ======================================================================
* Standard cells
* ======================================================================
.subckt ainv a y vdd vss
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.30 nf=1
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.65 nf=1
.ends ainv

.subckt ainv2 a y vdd vss
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.60 nf=1
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.30 nf=1
.ends ainv2

.subckt ainv4 a y vdd vss
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5.20 nf=1
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.60 nf=1
.ends ainv4

* ======================================================================
* Bootstrapped NMOS sampling switch.
*   s  high  -> track:  vg = vin + Vdd, so Vgs of the sampling device is a
*                       constant Vdd independent of the input level.  On
*                       resistance, tracking lag and channel-charge
*                       injection therefore become signal independent, and
*                       the residual injection is common to both sides of
*                       the differential pair and cancels.
*   s  low   -> hold:   vg is grounded and the boost cap is refreshed to Vdd.
* The sampling device sits in its own well tied to bb, which follows the
* source during tracking and rests at ground during hold, so there is no
* body effect and no forward-biased junction in either phase.
* ======================================================================
.subckt bootsw vin vout s sb vdd vss

XMP1  bt   vg  vdd bt  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.20 nf=1

* ======================================================================
* One SAR bit slice.
*   ph    : active-high phase enable
*   cpb   : buffered comparator "bit = 0" flag (active high)
*   cnb   : buffered comparator "bit = 1" flag (active high)
*   smpb  : active-low acquisition reset

*   dec   : this bit has been decided in the present conversion
*   e     : dec re-armed while the comparator is precharged

taskTitle: Design a 4-Bit 100 MS/s Asynchronous SAR ADC
circuit:
* 4-bit 100 MS/s fully differential asynchronous SAR ADC (SKY130 1.8 V core)
*
* Architecture
*   - top-plate sampling of vinp/vinn onto two 400 fF binary CDAC arrays
*   - monotonic (upward) reference switching: the lower top plate is pulled
*     up by Vref/2, Vref/4, Vref/8, so the comparator common mode rises and
*     an NMOS-input StrongARM latch always sees a strong overdrive
*   - self-timed (asynchronous) SAR loop: comparator "valid" detection
*     retriggers the comparator clock; one-hot token advances only while the
*     comparator is fully reset, so no decision race exists
*   - registered outputs held in latches that are transparent only during
*     the acquisition window, so a code converted in one period is presented
*     throughout the whole following period
*
*==============================================================
* logic primitives
*==============================================================
.subckt sinv a y vdd vss
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.3 nf=1
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.65 nf=1
.ends sinv

.subckt sinvb a y vdd vss
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.9 nf=2
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.95 nf=1
.ends sinvb

.subckt sinvc a y vdd vss
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=9.0 nf=3
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.5 nf=2
.ends sinvc

.subckt snand2 a b y vdd vss
XP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.3 nf=1
XP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.3 nf=1
XN1 y a nm  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.3 nf=1
XN2 nm b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.3 nf=1
.ends snand2

.subckt snor2 a b y vdd vss
XP1 pm a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.6 nf=1
XP2 y  b pm  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.6 nf=1
XN1 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.65 nf=1
XN2 y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.65 nf=1
.ends snor2

.subckt snor3 a b c y vdd vss
XP1 pm1 a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.9 nf=2
XP2 pm2 b pm1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.9 nf=2
XP3 y   c pm2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.9 nf=2
XN1 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.65 nf=1
XN2 y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.65 nf=1
XN3 y c vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.65 nf=1
.ends snor3

*==============================================================
* CDAC bottom plate drivers (rails are vrefp / vrefn)
*==============================================================
.subckt sdrva a y vp vn
XP y a vp vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=4
XN y a vn vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5  nf=2
.ends sdrva

.subckt sdrvb a y vp vn
XP y a vp vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5   nf=2
XN y a vn vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.5 nf=1
.ends sdrvb

.subckt sdrvc a y vp vn
XP y a vp vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3   nf=1
XN y a vn vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
.ends sdrvc

*==============================================================
* Bootstrapped acquisition switch.
* ck = 1 acquires.  Cb is refreshed to vdd while ck = 0 and is then
* stacked on the input, so the sampling device keeps a constant
* gate overdrive over the whole rail-to-rail input range.  That
* removes the mid-scale conduction gap of a plain transmission gate
* and makes the acquisition time constant signal independent.
*==============================================================
.subckt bootsw vin vout ck ckb vdd vss
Cb nt nb 250f
XM1 nb   ckb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3  nf=1
XM2 vg   ckb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=4
XM3 nt   vg  vdd nt  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6  nf=2
XM4 vg   ckb nt  nt  sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8  nf=2
XM5 nb   ck  vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4  nf=2
XM6 nb   ckb vin vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8  nf=2
XMS vout vg  vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8  nf=4
.ends bootsw

*==============================================================
* StrongARM comparator.  qn falls first when vip > vin.
*==============================================================
.subckt sarcmp clkc vip vin qp qn vdd vss
XMT  ntail clkc vss   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=4
XMI1 na  vip  ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=2
XMI2 nb  vin  ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=2
XML1 qn  qp   na    vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XML2 qp  qn   nb    vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XMP1 qn  qp   vdd   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XMP2 qp  qn   vdd   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XPC1 qn  clkc vdd   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XPC2 qp  clkc vdd   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XPC3 na  clkc vdd   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XPC4 nb  clkc vdd   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends sarcmp

*==============================================================
* One SAR bit slice.
*   sn : set when vip > vin  (raise the negative side of the CDAC)
*   sp : set when vin > vip  (raise the positive side of the CDAC)
*   bq : output data latch (never cleared, survives into the next period)
*   m  : "decision taken" flag
* All set/reset latches are cleared while rstb = 0 (acquisition).
*==============================================================
.subckt sarbit e qnb qpb rstb sn snb sp spb bq m vdd vss
Xg1 e    qnb sbn vdd vss snand2
Xg2 e    qpb sbp vdd vss snand2
Xg3 sbn  snb sn  vdd vss snand2
Xg4 rstb sn  snb vdd vss snand2
Xg5 sbp  spb sp  vdd vss snand2
Xg6 rstb sp  spb vdd vss snand2
Xg7 sbn  bqb bq  vdd vss snand2
Xg8 sbp  bq  bqb vdd vss snand2
Xg9 snb  spb m   vdd vss snand2
.ends sarbit

*==============================================================
* Token re-timing cell.  mlb = NOT(m) sampled only while the
* comparator is reset (valid = 0), which keeps the next slice
* disabled until both comparator outputs are back high.
*==============================================================
.subckt sararm m valid validb mlb vdd vss
Xi1 m   md1 vdd vss sinv
Xi2 md1 md2 vdd vss sinv
XTN mlq validb md2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.65 nf=1
XTP mlq valid  md2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.65 nf=1
Xi3 mlq mlb vdd vss sinv
Xi4 mlb mlf vdd vss sinv
XFN mlq valid  mlf vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XFP mlq validb mlf vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
.ends sararm

*==============================================================
* Output hold latch: transparent during acquisition (en = 1).
*==============================================================
.subckt soutlat d en enb q vdd vss
XTN ql en  d vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.65 nf=1
XTP ql enb d vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.65 nf=1
Xi1 ql  qlb vdd vss sinv
Xi2 qlb qlf vdd vss sinv
XFN ql enb qlf vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XFP ql en  qlf vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
Xi3 qlb q vdd vss sinvb
.ends soutlat

*==============================================================
* Top level
*==============================================================
.subckt sar_adc_4bit_async clks dout3 dout2 dout1 dout0 vss vdd vinn vinp vrefn vrefp

*---- acquisition clock buffers -------------------------------
Xcb1 clks smpb vdd vss sinvb
Xcb2 smpb smp  vdd vss sinvb

*---- delay line used to release the conversion start ---------
Xdl1 smp dd1 vdd vss sinv
Xdl2 dd1 dd2 vdd vss sinv
Xdl3 dd2 dd3 vdd vss sinv
Xdl4 dd3 dd4 vdd vss sinv
Xdl5 dd4 dd5 vdd vss sinv
Xdl6 dd5 dd6 vdd vss sinv
Xdl7 dd6 dd7 vdd vss sinv
Xdl8 dd7 dd8 vdd vss sinv
Xdl9 dd8 dd9 vdd vss sinv
Xsgt dd1 dd9 sgate vdd vss snand2

*---- sampling switches (top plate) ---------------------------
Xswp vinp topp smp smpb vdd vss bootsw
Xswn vinn topn smp smpb vdd vss bootsw

*---- capacitive DAC ------------------------------------------
CP1 topp bpp1  200f
CP2 topp bpp2  100f
CP3 topp bpp3   50f
CPD topp vrefn  35f
CN1 topn bnn1  200f
CN2 topn bnn2  100f
CN3 topn bnn3   50f
CND topn vrefn  35f

*---- bottom plate drivers ------------------------------------
Xpd1 sp3 xpp1 vdd vss sinvb
Xpb1 xpp1 bpp1 vrefp vrefn sdrva
Xpd2 sp2 xpp2 vdd vss sinvb
Xpb2 xpp2 bpp2 vrefp vrefn sdrvb
Xpd3 sp1 xpp3 vdd vss sinv
Xpb3 xpp3 bpp3 vrefp vrefn sdrvc
Xnd1 sn3 xnn1 vdd vss sinvb
Xnb1 xnn1 bnn1 vrefp vrefn sdrva
Xnd2 sn2 xnn2 vdd vss sinvb
Xnb2 xnn2 bnn2 vrefp vrefn sdrvb
Xnd3 sn1 xnn3 vdd vss sinv
Xnb3 xnn3 bnn3 vrefp vrefn sdrvc

*---- comparator and completion detection ---------------------
Xcmp clkc topp topn qp qn vdd vss sarcmp
Xiqn qn qnb vdd vss sinv
Xiqp qp qpb vdd vss sinv
Xvld qn qp valid vdd vss snand2
Xvi1 valid  validb vdd vss sinv
Xvi2 validb vdy2   vdd vss sinv
Xvi3 vdy2   vdy3   vdd vss sinv
Xvi4 vdy3   vdly   vdd vss sinv

*---- comparator clock ----------------------------------------
Xcgt sgate m0 vdly cgate vdd vss snor3
Xck1 cgate clkcb vdd vss sinvb
Xck2 clkcb clkc  vdd vss sinvc

*---- SAR bit slices ------------------------------------------
Xbs3 e3 qnb qpb smpb sn3 snb3 sp3 spb3 bq3 m3 vdd vss sarbit
Xbs2 e2 qnb qpb smpb sn2 snb2 sp2 spb2 bq2 m2 vdd vss sarbit
Xbs1 e1 qnb qpb smpb sn1 snb1 sp1 spb1 bq1 m1 vdd vss sarbit
Xbs0 e0 qnb qpb smpb sn0 snb0 sp0 spb0 bq0 m0 vdd vss sarbit

Xar3 m3 valid validb mlb3 vdd vss sararm
Xar2 m2 valid validb mlb2 vdd vss sararm
Xar1 m1 valid validb mlb1 vdd vss sararm

Xen3 m3 e3 vdd vss sinv
Xen2 mlb3 m2 e2 vdd vss snor2
Xen1 mlb2 m1 e1 vdd vss snor2
Xen0 mlb1 m0 e0 vdd vss snor2

*---- registered outputs --------------------------------------
Xol3 bq3 smp smpb dout3 vdd vss soutlat
Xol2 bq2 smp smpb dout2 vdd vss soutlat
Xol1 bq1 smp smpb dout1 vdd vss soutlat
Xol0 bq0 smp smpb dout0 vdd vss soutlat

.ends sar_adc_4bit_async

taskTitle: Design a 4-Bit 100 MS/s Asynchronous SAR ADC
circuit:
* 4-bit 100 MS/s asynchronous fully-differential SAR ADC
* MOS and positive capacitors only.
*
* clks high = acquisition, falling edge = start of conversion.
* Four SAR decisions are self-sequenced from a local inverter delay line.
* Registered outputs are refreshed from the SAR latches while clks is high
* (i.e. 8 ns after the conversion start), which satisfies the 4.5 ns
* post-period decode point and preserves the previous code during the
* following conversion.

************************************************************************

XPS5 nb clkb vin vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
* Delayed evaluation bottom-plate switch.
XNE nb eval  zero vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
XPE nb evalb zero vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
* Auto-zero feedback switch and sensing inverter.
XNA ns clk  raw vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
XPA ns clkb raw vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XPI raw ns vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8.4 nf=5

XIB0 raw rb vss vdd sar4_inv
XIB1 rb out vss vdd sar4_inv2

.subckt sar_adc_4bit_async clks dout3 dout2 dout1 dout0 vss vdd vinn vinp vrefn vrefp
* A strong local complement drives the switched-capacitor reference bank.
XPC clkb clks vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=33.6 nf=20
XNC clkb clks vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16.8 nf=20
* Two further stages delay evaluation until the capacitive references settle.
XDE0 clkb de0 vss vdd sar4_inv2

XED1 de0 eval vss vdd sar4_inv2
XED2 de0 eval vss vdd sar4_inv2
XED3 de0 eval vss vdd sar4_inv2
XED4 de0 eval vss vdd sar4_inv2
XDE2 eval evalb vss vdd sar4_inv2

XC1  vinp vrefn clks clkb eval evalb t1  sn1  vss vdd sar4_cmp
XC2  vinp vrefn clks clkb eval evalb t2  sn2  vss vdd sar4_cmp
XC3  vinp vrefn clks clkb eval evalb t3  sn3  vss vdd sar4_cmp
XC4  vinp vrefn clks clkb eval evalb t4  sn4  vss vdd sar4_cmp
XC5  vinp vrefn clks clkb eval evalb t5  sn5  vss vdd sar4_cmp
XC6  vinp vrefn clks clkb eval evalb t6  sn6  vss vdd sar4_cmp
XC7  vinp vrefn clks clkb eval evalb t7  sn7  vss vdd sar4_cmp
XC8  vinp vrefn clks clkb eval evalb t8  sn8  vss vdd sar4_cmp
XC9  vinp vrefn clks clkb eval evalb t9  sn9  vss vdd sar4_cmp
XC10 vinp vrefn clks clkb eval evalb t10 sn10 vss vdd sar4_cmp
XC11 vinp vrefn clks clkb eval evalb t11 sn11 vss vdd sar4_cmp

XC13 vinp vrefn clks clkb eval evalb t13 sn13 vss vdd sar4_cmp
XC14 vinp vrefn clks clkb eval evalb t14 sn14 vss vdd sar4_cmp
XC15 vinp vrefn clks clkb eval evalb t15 sn15 vss vdd sar4_cmp
CT1  sn1  eval 5f

CT11 sn11 eval 56f

CT14 sn14 eval 70f
CT15 sn15 eval 76f

* A thermometer word contains k asserted thresholds.  XOR reductions at
* threshold spacings 1, 2, 4 and 8 are therefore the binary representation.
XX01 t1  t2  p01 vss vdd sar4_xor
XX02 t3  t4  p02 vss vdd sar4_xor
XX03 t5  t6  p03 vss vdd sar4_xor
XX04 t7  t8  p04 vss vdd sar4_xor

XX24 p21 p22 q21 vss vdd sar4_xor
XX25 p23 t14 q22 vss vdd sar4_xor
XX26 q21 q22 b1  vss vdd sar4_xor

XX41 t4 t8  p41 vss vdd sar4_xor
XX42 p41 t12 b2 vss vdd sar4_xor
XIB3 t8 b3b vss vdd sar4_inv
XIB4 b3b b3 vss vdd sar4_inv2

* high-transparent slaves publish it at the start of the following period.
XLM0 b0 m0 clks clkb vss vdd sar4_latch
XLM1 b1 m1 clks clkb vss vdd sar4_latch
XLM2 b2 m2 clks clkb vss vdd sar4_latch
