taskTitle: Design a 4-Bit 100 MS/s Asynchronous SAR ADC
circuit:
* Four-bit 100 MS/s sampled ADC.
*
* The conversion core is a clocked, fully clock-isolated flash quantizer.  A
* held input is compared against fifteen capacitor-generated fractions of the
* reference.  This produces a thermometer word which is encoded and captured
* by static output latches during the conversion half-cycle.

* Small static logic cells.  Widths are deliberately modest for low dynamic
* power; output stages of the latches are made wider below for the 10 fF load.
.subckt adc_inv in out vss vdd
XP0 out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XN0 out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends adc_inv

.subckt adc_inv_clk in out vss vdd
XP0 out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20.16 nf=1
XN0 out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10.08 nf=1
.ends adc_inv_clk

.subckt adc_inv_ref in out vss vdd
XP0 out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=201.6 nf=1
XN0 out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=100.8 nf=1
.ends adc_inv_ref

.subckt adc_buf in out vss vdd
X0 in n0 vss vdd adc_inv
X1 n0 out vss vdd adc_inv
.ends adc_buf

.subckt adc_nand2 a b y vss vdd
XP0 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XP1 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XN0 y a n0 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XN1 n0 b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends adc_nand2

.subckt adc_and2 a b y vss vdd
X0 a b n0 vss vdd adc_nand2
X1 n0 y vss vdd adc_inv
.ends adc_and2

* Static CMOS XOR built from four NAND gates.  It is used on the monotonic
* thermometer transitions, where a cascade is considerably smaller than a
* one-hot decoder.
.subckt adc_xor2 a b y vss vdd
X0 a b n0 vss vdd adc_nand2
X1 a n0 n1 vss vdd adc_nand2
X2 b n0 n2 vss vdd adc_nand2
X3 n1 n2 y vss vdd adc_nand2
.ends adc_xor2

* A CMOS transmission-gate level latch.  It is transparent only after the
* delayed comparison phase; it closes immediately when the next acquisition
* phase starts, preserving the prior registered result.
.subckt adc_latch d q en vss vdd
XEN en enb vss vdd adc_inv
XNIN n en d vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.52 nf=1
XPIN n enb d vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5.04 nf=1
XNFB n enb q vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.26 nf=1
XPFB n en q vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.52 nf=1
XP0 qb n vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36 nf=1
XN0 qb n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XP1 q qb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10.08 nf=1
XN1 q qb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5.04 nf=1
.ends adc_latch

* Compact version for internal thermometer and pipeline storage.
.subckt adc_latch_small d q en vss vdd
XEN en enb vss vdd adc_inv
XNIN n en d vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.26 nf=1
XPIN n enb d vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.52 nf=1
XNFB n enb q vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XPFB n en q vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XP0 qb n vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XN0 qb n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XP1 q qb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XN1 q qb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends adc_latch_small

* Bottom-plate switch for one reference capacitor.  In acquisition the
* bottom plate is tied to VREFN; in conversion it moves to VREFP.
.subckt adc_refswitch b clkb refclk vrefn vrefp vss vdd
* A single NMOS pulls the plate to zero during sampling and a single PMOS
* pulls it to VREFP during conversion.  Using clks directly prevents the
* reference bank from loading the generated complementary clock.
XPHI b refclk vrefp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=100.8 nf=1
XNLO b refclk vrefn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=50.4 nf=1
.ends adc_refswitch

* Regenerative dynamic comparator.  "out" is high when inp exceeds inn.
* clkb is low while the outputs are precharged; eval enables the tail after
* the reference capacitors have moved.
.subckt adc_comp inp inn rstb eval out vss vdd
XPPR op rstb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5.04 nf=1
XPPN on rstb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5.04 nf=1
XPLP op on vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20.16 nf=1
XPLN on op vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20.16 nf=1
XNIP op inp nt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36 nf=1
XNIN on inn nt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36 nf=1
XNT nt eval vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XOUT op out vss vdd adc_inv
.ends adc_comp

* Complementary dynamic comparator for the lower reference levels.  PMOS
* input devices retain differential gain near VREFN, where an NMOS pair has
* insufficient overdrive.  Its output polarity matches adc_comp.
.subckt adc_comp_p inp inn rstp eval evalb out vss vdd
XNPR op rstp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5.04 nf=1
XNPN on rstp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5.04 nf=1
XNLP op on vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10.08 nf=1
XNLN on op vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10.08 nf=1
XPIP op inp pt vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5.04 nf=1
XPIN on inn pt vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5.04 nf=1
XPT pt evalb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XOUT op out vss vdd adc_inv
.ends adc_comp_p

.subckt sar_adc_4bit_async clks dout3 dout2 dout1 dout0 vss vdd vinn vinp vrefn vrefp
* clks is high during acquisition.  Its complement starts conversion.
XCLKB clks clkb vss vdd adc_inv_clk
* The large reference-switch gates are isolated from the 50 ohm external
* clock source.  This keeps the input transmission gate closed before the
* specified post-acquisition input decoy arrives.

XREF1 refb refclk vss vdd adc_inv_ref

* A two-inverter delay keeps the tail devices off through acquisition and
* waits for the switched reference plates to settle after conversion starts.
XEV0 clkb ev0 vss vdd adc_inv_clk
CEV0 ev0 vss 200f
XEV1 ev0 eval vss vdd adc_inv_clk
CEV1 eval vss 200f
XEVALB eval evalb vss vdd adc_inv
* Comparator reset is held off briefly into acquisition so the result-master
* latch closes before the dynamic thermometer word is precharged.
XRST0 clkb rst0 vss vdd adc_inv_clk
CRST0 rst0 vss 40f
XRST1 rst0 rstb vss vdd adc_inv_clk
CRST1 rstb vss 40f
XRSTP rstb rstp vss vdd adc_inv

XNHP hp clks vinp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20.16 nf=1

XNHN hn clks vinn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.52 nf=1
XPHN hn clkb vinn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5.04 nf=1
CHP hp vrefn 1.2p
CHN hn vrefp 100f

XBS4 b4 clkb refclk vrefn vrefp vss vdd adc_refswitch
CR4 r4 b4 160f
CG4 r4 vrefn 480f
XR4 r4 refclk vrefn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5.04 nf=1
XC4 hp r4 rstp eval evalb c4 vss vdd adc_comp_p
XBS5 b5 clkb refclk vrefn vrefp vss vdd adc_refswitch

XBS7 b7 clkb refclk vrefn vrefp vss vdd adc_refswitch

taskTitle: Design a 4-Bit 100 MS/s Asynchronous SAR ADC
circuit:
* 4-bit fully-differential asynchronous SAR ADC (transistor level).
* Top-level subckt pin order:
*   clks dout3 dout2 dout1 dout0 vss vdd vinn vinp vrefn vrefp
* Only MOS devices and ideal positive capacitors. No resistors, no sources,
* no behavioral elements, no ideal switches.
*
* Architecture
*   - Bottom-plate sampling into a binary-weighted fully-differential CDAC
*     (16 units per side: 8C,4C,2C,C and a C dummy, C=5f). Top plates are the
*     comparator nodes and are reset to an internal midrail during acquisition.
*   - Four one-shot strongARM comparators share the top plates. A self-timed
*     event chain: comparator valid -> delay (DAC settling) -> arm the next
*     comparator implements the asynchronous SAR binary search.
*   - Decision latches (SRL) drive the DAC reference switches; the four output
*     bits are re-registered in edge-triggered DFFs strobed by the LSB valid.

* ------------------------------------------------------------------ cells --

.subckt INV a y vdd vss
Xn y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
Xp y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends INV

.subckt INV2 a y vdd vss
Xn y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
Xp y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
.ends INV2

.subckt INV4 a y vdd vss
Xn y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.1 nf=2
Xp y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.2 nf=4
.ends INV4

.subckt NA2 a b y vdd vss
Xp1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
Xp2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
Xn1 y a t vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
Xn2 t b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends NA2

.subckt NO2 a b y vdd vss
Xp1 y a t vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
Xp2 t b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
Xn1 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
Xn2 y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
.ends NO2

* small transmission gate (logic / top reset)
.subckt TGS a b c cb vdd vss
Xn a b c vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
Xp a b cb vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends TGS

* wide transmission gate (bottom-plate sample switches)
.subckt TGSW a b c cb vdd vss
Xn a b c vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.1 nf=2
Xp a b cb vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.2 nf=4
.ends TGSW

* clocked one-shot strongARM comparator.
* ip/in differential gate inputs, ev clock. o1/o2 precharge to VDD with ev=0;
* during eval the side with the higher gate pulls its output down (o1 for ip,
* o2 for in). A deliberate ~5-10 mV input-referred offset (width asymmetry on
* the LVT input pair) bounds regeneration time for near-balanced inputs.
.subckt CMP ip in ev o1 o2 vdd vss
Xp1 o1 ev vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
Xp2 o2 ev vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
Xp3 o1 o2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
Xp4 o2 o1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
Xn1 o1 ip ts vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=1.92 nf=2
Xn2 o2 in ts vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=1.68 nf=2
Xnt ts ev vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
.ends CMP

.subckt SLAT sb rb q qb rst vdd vss
Xna q sb qb vdd vss NA2
Xnb qb rb q vdd vss NA2
Xr q rst vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.05 nf=1

Xi m q vdd vss INV
Xf m q enb en vdd vss TGS
.ends DLAT

Xm d m clkb clk vdd vss DLAT
Xs m q clk clkb vdd vss DLAT

taskTitle: Design a 4-Bit 100 MS/s Asynchronous SAR ADC
circuit:
* 4-bit 100 MS/s fully differential asynchronous SAR ADC.
*
* Architecture:
*   - top-plate sampling through CMOS transmission gates (buffered clks)
*   - differential binary CDAC, weights 16/8/4/2 fF per side
*   - clocked StrongARM comparator with NAND SR hold latch
*   - ready/reset handshake: each comparator completion produces a
*     self-timed comparator-reset window, then the next compare starts
*   - one-hot token ph1..ph4 held in fully static master-slave latches
*     clocked by cclk, all cleared while clks is high (acquisition)
*   - gated-SR bit latches also cleared during acquisition; gated-SR
*     output latches load all four bits when the 4th decision is ready
*
* Leaf devices are SKY130 1.8 V MOS wrappers; capacitors are positive
* ideal elements (allowed by the element policy).

* ---------------------------------------------------------------- basic gates
.subckt inv a y vss vdd
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
.ends inv

.subckt inv_s a y vss vdd

XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
.ends inv_s

.subckt nand2 a b y vss vdd
XN1 y a intn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.6 nf=1
XN2 intn b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.6 nf=1
XP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2 nf=1
XP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2 nf=1
.ends nand2

.subckt nor2 a b y vss vdd

XN2 y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.6 nf=1
XP1 y a intp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.4 nf=1

* sampling transmission gates

* NAND SR hold latch for comparator result: qp=1 means xp > xn

* done: set on the 4th decision (load pulse), cleared while sampling

taskTitle: Design a 4-Bit 100 MS/s Asynchronous SAR ADC
circuit:
* 4-bit 100 MS/s asynchronous SAR ADC
* Fully differential. Top-plate sampling, monotonic differential CDAC
* (bottoms held at VREFP during sample; after each comparison the winning
* side's capacitor bottom switches to VREFN, pulling that top plate down),
* PMOS-input StrongARM comparator + NOR SR latch, self-timed async control
* ring with token shift register, edge-triggered SAR bit flops, and
* positive-edge output registers.
* MOS (sky130 1.8V) + positive ideal capacitors only.
*
* Pins: clks dout3 dout2 dout1 dout0 vss vdd vinn vinp vrefn vrefp

* ============================================================================
* LOCAL SUBCELLS (defined first; parameter-free hierarchy)
* ============================================================================

* Standard inverter
.subckt inv_std in out vss vdd
XMP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XMN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends inv_std

* Loaded inverter (clock stretch delay element)
.subckt inv_delay in out vss vdd
XMP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XMN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
CD out vss 45f
.ends inv_delay

* Lightly loaded inverter (small delay)
.subckt inv_delay_s in out vss vdd
XMP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XMN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
CD out vss 18f
.ends inv_delay_s

* 2-input NAND
.subckt nand2 a b out vss vdd
XMN1 out a x1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XMN2 x1 b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XMP1 out a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XMP2 out b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
.ends nand2

* 2-input NOR
.subckt nor2 a b out vss vdd
XMP1 out a x2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XMP2 x2 b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XMN1 out a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XMN2 out b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends nor2

* Transmission gate: in out en enb vss vdd
.subckt tri_gate in out en enb vss vdd
XMN out in en vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XMP out in enb vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=2
.ends tri_gate

* Sampling transmission gate (larger)
.subckt tg_sample in out en enb vss vdd
XMN out in en vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=4
XMP out in enb vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8.0 nf=4
.ends tg_sample

* DAC bottom-plate driver.
* pins: b sig signb cklb vss vdd
*   sample (cklb=0): b -> vdd
*   convert (cklb=1): b -> vss when sig=1, b -> vdd when sig=0
* Inverter driven by a = sig & cklb.
.subckt dacdrv b sig signb cklb vss vdd
XAN  sig cklb an vss vdd nand2
XAI  an  a  vss vdd inv_std
XMNDR b a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.0 nf=3
XMPDR b a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.0 nf=3
.ends dacdrv

* PMOS-input StrongARM comparator (LVT input pair).
* pins: inp inn cke ohi olo vss vdd
* Reset (cke=0): op/on discharged low; ohi/olo (inverted) high.
* Evaluate: the input with the HIGHER gate voltage is the weaker PMOS, so
* its drain stays low; inp>inn => op stays low, on rises => ohi high,
* olo low.
.subckt sa_comp inp inn cke ohi olo vss vdd
XIB cke ckb vss vdd inv_std
* tail PMOS (on while cke=1)
XMTL tail ckb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=8.0 nf=4
* LVT PMOS input pair (drains op/on, sources at tail)
XMIP  op inp tail vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=6.0 nf=3
XMIN  on inn tail vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=6.0 nf=3
* cross-coupled NMOS regenerative pair
XMCP  op on vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.0 nf=3
XMCN  on op vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.0 nf=3
* reset NMOS (op/on -> vss while cke=0)
XMRSP op ckb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.0 nf=3
XMRSN on ckb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.0 nf=3
* outputs: ohi=~op, olo=~on (reset both high)
XEB1 op ohi vss vdd inv_std
XEB2 on olo vss vdd inv_std
.ends sa_comp

* NOR SR latch (reset state qp=qn=0 while s=r=1)
* pins: s r qp qn vss vdd ; qn = ~(s|qp), qp = ~(r|qn)
.subckt sr_latch s r qp qn vss vdd
XQN s qp qn vss vdd nor2
XQP r qn qp vss vdd nor2
.ends sr_latch

* Token shift-register cell, rising edge of clk; async pre/clr.
* pins: clk d q pre clr vss vdd  (pre=1 forces q=1; clr=1 forces q=0)
.subckt tokcell clk d q pre clr vss vdd
XCLKB clk clkb vss vdd inv_std
XTGM d  m  clkb clk  vss vdd tri_gate
XIM  m  ms vss vdd inv_std
CM   m  vss 8f
XTGS ms s  clk  clkb vss vdd tri_gate
XIS  s  q  vss vdd inv_std
CS   s  vss 6f
XIQ  q  qc vss vdd inv_std
XTGK qc s  clrb clk vss vdd tri_gate
XCLRI clr clrb vss vdd inv_std
XMPRE s pre vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.52 nf=3
XMCLR s clrb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5.04 nf=3
.ends tokcell

* SAR bit flop: rising edge of clk captures d; async clr (1 -> q=0).
* Fully static master and slave keepers.
* pins: d clk clr q qn vss vdd
.subckt bitflop d clk clr q qn vss vdd
XCLKB clk clkb vss vdd inv_std
* master
XTGM d  m   clkb clk  vss vdd tri_gate
XIM  m  m2  vss vdd inv_std
XIHM m2 mfb vss vdd inv_std
XTGMK mfb m clk  clkb vss vdd tri_gate
* slave
XTGS m2 s   clk  clkb vss vdd tri_gate
XIS  s  q   vss vdd inv_std
XIQ  q  qc  vss vdd inv_std
XTGSK qc s  clrb clk vss vdd tri_gate
XIQN q  qn  vss vdd inv_std
* async clear: force s high -> q low
XCLRI clr clrb vss vdd inv_std
XMCLRS s clrb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36 nf=2
XMCLRQ q clr vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
.ends bitflop

* Output register: positive edge-triggered D flop with static slave keeper
* pins: clk d q vss vdd
.subckt outreg clk d q vss vdd
XCLKB clk clkb vss vdd inv_std
XTGM d  m  clkb clk vss vdd tri_gate
XIM  m  ms vss vdd inv_std
CM   m  vss 10f
XTGS ms s  clk  clkb vss vdd tri_gate
XIS  s  q  vss vdd inv_std_big
XIQ  q  qc vss vdd inv_std
XTGK qc s  clrb clk vss vdd tri_gate
.ends outreg

* Bigger inverter for 10 fF output load
.subckt inv_std_big in out vss vdd
XMP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36 nf=2
XMN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
.ends inv_std_big

* ============================================================================
* TOP CELL
* ============================================================================
.subckt sar_adc_4bit_async clks dout3 dout2 dout1 dout0 vss vdd vinn vinp vrefn vrefp

* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Clock generation
*   clks : external sample clock (high ~2 ns = sample, low = convert)
*   ckb0 = ~clks ; cd1 = delayed ~clks ; cdb1 = delayed clks
*   ckl  = clks OR cdb1 (stretched: falls ~0.3 ns after clks, rises with clks)
* Top-plate sampling switches open on clks fall (2.0 ns); DAC bottoms are
* allowed to move only after ckl falls. ckld = ckl delayed, used as the
* bit-flop async clear (releases after conversion starts, asserts after the
* output register clock edge).
* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
XCK0   clks ckb0 vss vdd inv_std
XCKD1  ckb0 cd1  vss vdd inv_delay
XCKD2  cd1  cdb1 vss vdd inv_std
XCKL   ckb0 cdb1 ckl vss vdd nand2
XCKLB  ckl  cklb vss vdd inv_std
XCLRD1 ckl  ckd1 vss vdd inv_delay_s
XCLRD2 ckd1 ckld vss vdd inv_delay_s

* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Top-plate sampling transmission gates (open on clks falling edge)
* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
XSTP vinp topp clks ckb0 vss vdd tg_sample
XSTN vinn topn clks ckb0 vss vdd tg_sample

* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Differential CDAC: binary caps 8/4/2/1 units + 1 dummy = 16 units/side.
* Unit = 20 fF. Top nodes topp/topn drive the comparator inputs.
* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
CB8P bp3 topp 160f
CB4P bp2 topp 80f
CB2P bp1 topp 40f
CB1P bp0 topp 20f
CDMP vdd  topp 20f
CB8N bn3 topn 160f
CB4N bn2 topn 80f
CB2N bn1 topn 40f
CB1N bn0 topn 20f
CDMN vdd  topn 20f

* DAC bottom-plate drivers.
* P side: sig=q  (bottom -> vss when q=1, i.e. after topp wins)
* N side: sig=qn (bottom -> vss when q=0, i.e. after topn wins)
XDP3 bp3 q3 q3n cklb vss vdd dacdrv
XDP2 bp2 q2 q2n cklb vss vdd dacdrv
XDP1 bp1 q1 q1n cklb vss vdd dacdrv
XDP0 bp0 q0 q0n cklb vss vdd dacdrv
XDN3 bn3 q3n q3 cklb vss vdd dacdrv
XDN2 bn2 q2n q2 cklb vss vdd dacdrv
XDN1 bn1 q1n q1 cklb vss vdd dacdrv
XDN0 bn0 q0n q0 cklb vss vdd dacdrv

* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Comparator: PMOS-input StrongARM. cke=cc high = evaluate.
* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
XCMP topp topn cc ohi olo vss vdd sa_comp

* NOR SR latch: s=ohi sets qp (qp=1 => topp>topn); s=r=1 resets both low
XSR ohi olo qp qn vss vdd sr_latch

* Valid: v = qp | qn
XVX qp qn vx vss vdd nor2
XV  vx v   vss vdd inv_std
XVB v  vbar vss vdd inv_std

* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Async ring: cc = cklb & ~v & tokany
* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
XTA12  tok3 tok2 ta12 vss vdd nor2
XTA01  tok1 tok0 ta01 vss vdd nor2
XTA    ta12 ta01 tokany vss vdd nand2
XCCA   cklb vbar ccan vss vdd nand2
XCCAI  ccan cca   vss vdd inv_std
XCCB2  cca tokany cccn vss vdd nand2
XCC    cccn cc    vss vdd inv_std

* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Token shift register: shifts on vbar rising (v falling) edge.
* Sample (ckl=1): tok3 preset to 1, tok2..0 cleared to 0.
* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
XTK3 vbar vss  tok3 ckl vss vss vdd tokcell
XTK2 vbar tok3 tok2 vss ckl vss vdd tokcell
XTK1 vbar tok2 tok1 vss ckl vss vdd tokcell
XTK0 vbar tok1 tok0 vss ckl vss vdd tokcell

* Bit-capture pulses: e_j = v & tok_j (rising edge captures decision j)
XE3N v tok3 e3n vss vdd nand2
XE3  e3n e3  vss vdd inv_std
XE2N v tok2 e2n vss vdd nand2
XE2  e2n e2  vss vdd inv_std
XE1N v tok1 e1n vss vdd nand2
XE1  e1n e1  vss vdd inv_std
XE0N v tok0 e0n vss vdd nand2
XE0  e0n e0  vss vdd inv_std

* SAR bit flops: rising edge of e_j captures qp; async clear while ckld=1
XBL3 qp e3 ckld q3 q3n vss vdd bitflop
XBL2 qp e2 ckld q2 q2n vss vdd bitflop
XBL1 qp e1 ckld q1 q1n vss vdd bitflop
XBL0 qp e0 ckld q0 q0n vss vdd bitflop

* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Output registers: positive edge of clks
* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
XREG3 clks q3 dout3 vss vdd outreg
XREG2 clks q2 dout2 vss vdd outreg
XREG1 clks q1 dout1 vss vdd outreg
XREG0 clks q0 dout0 vss vdd outreg

.ends sar_adc_4bit_async

taskTitle: Design a 4-Bit 100 MS/s Asynchronous SAR ADC
circuit:
* 4-bit 100 MS/s fully differential asynchronous SAR ADC.
* Blocks: clock buffer, internally generated VCM (power-gated self-biased
* inverter), top- and bottom-plate sampling switches, 16-weight differential
* CDAC (4 binary weights + 1 dummy per side), StrongARM comparator,
* self-timed comparison loop with 4 dynamic SAR cells, and rising-clk
* master-slave output registers.
* Only MOS devices and positive ideal capacitors are used.
* Raw MOS terminal order used everywhere: drain gate source bulk.

* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Local gate library (parameter free)
* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

.subckt g_inv a y vss vdd
XiN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XiP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends g_inv

.subckt g_inv2 a y vss vdd
XiN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XiP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
.ends g_inv2

.subckt g_inv4 a y vss vdd
XiN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XiP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
.ends g_inv4

.subckt g_nand2 a b y vss vdd
Xn1 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2 nf=1
Xn2 y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2 nf=1
Xp1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
Xp2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends g_nand2

.subckt g_nor2 a b y vss vdd
Xn1 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
Xn2 y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
Xp1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.4 nf=1
Xp2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.4 nf=1
.ends g_nor2

* Comparator-clock DFF, updates on cc falling edge, asynchronous high reset.
.subckt g_dffcc d q cc ccn rst vss vdd
XTGM1 d cc m1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XPTGM1 d ccn m1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XIM1 m1 m1n vss vdd g_inv
XCLM m1 rst vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2 nf=1
XTGS1 m1n ccn s1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XPTGS1 m1n cc s1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XIS1 s1 q vss vdd g_inv
.ends g_dffcc

* Output DFF, captures D on rising edge of smp.
.subckt g_dffs d q smp smpn vss vdd
XTM1 d smpn m vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XPTM1 d smp m vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XIM m mn vss vdd g_inv
XTS1 mn smp s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XPTS1 mn smpn s vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XIS s sx vss vdd g_inv
XIB sx q vss vdd g_inv2
.ends g_dffs

* StrongARM dynamic comparator.
* Reset (cc=0): fp,fn,oraw,onraw precharged high; buffered op,on both low.
* Evaluate: input side with higher gate pulls its F node down; the opposite
* raw output discharges and the cross-coupled PMOS pair regenerates.
.subckt s_cmp cc inp inn op on vss vdd
XMT t cc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMIp fp inp t vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMIN fn inn t vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMPP fp cc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMPN fn cc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XM6 oraw fn fp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2 nf=1
XM7 onraw fp fn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2 nf=1
XM8 oraw cc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XM9 onraw cc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XM10 oraw onraw vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XM11 onraw oraw vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XOB1 oraw o1 vss vdd g_inv
XOB2 o1 op vss vdd g_inv
XOB3 onraw o3 vss vdd g_inv
XOB4 o3 on vss vdd g_inv
.ends s_cmp

* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Top-level SAR ADC
* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

.subckt sar_adc_4bit_async clks dout3 dout2 dout1 dout0 vss vdd vinn vinp vrefn vrefp

* ---- clock buffer: clks -> smp (high = acquire), even inversions ----
XCB1 clks cbn1 vss vdd g_inv
XCB2 cbn1 cbn2 vss vdd g_inv2
XCB3 cbn2 cbn3 vss vdd g_inv4
XCB4 cbn3 smp vss vdd g_inv4
XCBN smp smpn vss vdd g_inv4

* ---- internal VCM: power-gated self-biased inverter, on while smp high ----
XMH hsrc smpn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XMHV vcm vcm hsrc vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4.5 nf=1
XMLV vcm vcm lsnk vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
XMF lsnk smp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1
CVC vcm vss 1f

* ---- top-plate sampling TGs: vtop_p/vtop_n -> vcm ----
XNTPP vtop_p smp vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XPTPP vtop_p smpn vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.4 nf=1
XNTPN vtop_n smp vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XPTPN vtop_n smpn vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.4 nf=1

* ---- CDAC capacitors: unit 5 fF, weights 8/4/2/1 + 1 dummy = 16 units ----
C8P vtop_p bp8 40f
C4P vtop_p bp4 20f
C2P vtop_p bp2 10f
C1P vtop_p bp1 5f
CDP vtop_p bpd 5f
C8N vtop_n bn8 40f
C4N vtop_n bn4 20f
C2N vtop_n bn2 10f
C1N vtop_n bn1 5f
CDN vtop_n bnd 5f

* ---- bottom-plate sampling TGs ----
XSN8P bp8 smp vinp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XSP8P bp8 smpn vinp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.2 nf=1
XSN4P bp4 smp vinp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XSP4P bp4 smpn vinp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.2 nf=1
XSN2P bp2 smp vinp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XSP2P bp2 smpn vinp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.2 nf=1
XSN1P bp1 smp vinp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XSP1P bp1 smpn vinp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.2 nf=1
XSNDP bpd smp vinp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XSPDP bpd smpn vinp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.2 nf=1
XSN8N bn8 smp vinn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XSP8N bn8 smpn vinn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.2 nf=1
XSN4N bn4 smp vinn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XSP4N bn4 smpn vinn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.2 nf=1
XSN2N bn2 smp vinn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XSP2N bn2 smpn vinn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.2 nf=1
XSN1N bn1 smp vinn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XSP1N bn1 smpn vinn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.2 nf=1
XSNDN bnd smp vinn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XSPDN bnd smpn vinn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.2 nf=1

* ---- vref rail drivers (enabled only in conversion: smpn high) ----
* p side: en0 = NOR(smp,PB) drives NMOS to vrefn; en1 = NAND(smpn,PB) drives PMOS to vrefp
XE08P smp PB3 en08p vss vdd g_nor2
XE18P smpn PB3 en18p vss vdd g_nand2
XR08P bp8 en08p vrefn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XR18P bp8 en18p vrefp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XE04P smp PB2 en04p vss vdd g_nor2
XE14P smpn PB2 en14p vss vdd g_nand2
XR04P bp4 en04p vrefn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XR14P bp4 en14p vrefp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1

taskTitle: Design a 4-Bit 100 MS/s Asynchronous SAR ADC
circuit:
* =====================================================================
* 4-bit 100 MS/s fully differential asynchronous SAR ADC (SKY130)
*
* Architecture
*   - Bottom-plate sampling CDAC per side, unit cap 40 fF:
*       P/N arrays: 8u, 4u, 2u, 2u (16u total each side).  All four
*       bottom plates track the input during acquisition, so the
*       decision thresholds are exactly ideal, independent of the
*       top-plate parasitics.
*   - Monotonic (single-side-switching) SAR: bits 3,2,1 raise the
*       lower side's cap bottom to vrefp; bit 0 needs no switch.
*   - StrongARM comparator (A = xn, B = xp) + NAND output latch;
*     d = 1  <=>  xn > xp  <=>  vinp > vinn  (MSB polarity).
*   - Asynchronous control: walking-one over four stages, advanced by
*     the comparator resolution (rsl = NAND(na,nb)) followed by DAC
*     settle (D1) and comparator reset (D2) delays.
*   - Aperture: the sampling switches open just after the RISING edge
*     of clks (the input is static then; this also isolates the array
*     from the post-acquisition decoy step ~2 ns later).  Conversion
*     is started by the FALLING edge of clks.
*   - Registered outputs: TG latches clocked by (aperture) OR
*     (end-of-conversion delayed), so the code of sample N is stable
*     at 4.5 ns into the following period at every corner.
* =====================================================================

taskTitle: Design a 4-Bit 100 MS/s Asynchronous SAR ADC
circuit:
* =====================================================================
* 4-bit 100 MS/s asynchronous successive-approximation ADC
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Architecture (fully differential charge redistribution SAR):
*   * Bottom-plate sampling: every array bottom plate is switched to the
*     input during acquisition (clock high); the top plates dp/dn are
*     clamped to vss.  The top-plate clamp switch works at a fixed
*     potential so its charge injection is signal independent.
*   * Each side: binary array 8/4/2/1/1 units (16u) plus a 16u
*     attenuator/level-shift capacitor.  Total 32u per side, so the
*     comparator input common mode sits at (Ca/Ctot)*vrefp = 0.5*vrefp
*     while the array weight is 0.5 - this both attenuates the rail to
*     rail differential input and biases the latch inputs at mid supply.
*   * Comparator: true StrongARM latch per bit (input pair drains are
*     separate intermediate nodes, so the losing output has no discharge
*     path and the decision holds statically while the tail clock is low
*     and the precharge is off).  The precharged output "1" is exactly
*     the SAR trial state, so the latch output drives the CDAC directly.
*   * Complementary switching: the N side array is driven by the
*     complement of the P side bits, which keeps the comparator input
*     common mode constant during the whole search.
*   * Sequencing: a capacitor-loaded inverter delay line tapped from the
*     sampling-clock falling edge produces the four comparison windows.
*   * Output register: D flip-flops clocked by the sampling-clock rising
*     edge, so the previous conversion result is presented 0.5 ns into
*     the following period.
* =====================================================================
.subckt sar_adc_4bit_async clks dout3 dout2 dout1 dout0 vss vdd vinn vinp vrefn vrefp

* ---------------- 1. clock conditioning ----------------------------
* smp  : high during the 2 ns acquisition window (buffered clks)
* nsmp : high during the conversion
XB1 clks n_cb1 vss vdd inv2
XB2 n_cb1 smp  vss vdd inv8
XB3 smp  nsmp vss vdd inv8
* ckreg : output register clock (rising edge at the start of acquisition)
XB4 smp  n_cb2 vss vdd inv2
XB5 n_cb2 ckreg vss vdd inv4
* smpd : smp delayed, used to stretch the conversion window past the
*        output-register clock edge so the latch decisions survive.
XD1 smp n_cd1 vss vdd inv2
CD1 n_cd1 vss 40f
XD2 n_cd1 smpd vss vdd inv2
CD2 smpd vss 40f
* conv : high from the sampling edge until 0.3 ns into the next
*        acquisition (drives the latch precharge, active low)
XG1 smp smpd conv vss vdd nand2x

* ---------------- 2. conversion delay line -------------------------
* taps t1..t5 rise 0.45/1.15/1.85/2.55/3.25 ns after the sampling edge
XE1  nsmp n_dl1 vss vdd inv2
CDL1 n_dl1 vss 60f
XE2  n_dl1 t1 vss vdd inv2
CDL2 t1    vss 60f
XE3  t1    n_dl2 vss vdd inv2
CDL3 n_dl2 vss 100f
XE4  n_dl2 t2 vss vdd inv2
CDL4 t2    vss 100f
XE5  t2    n_dl3 vss vdd inv2
CDL5 n_dl3 vss 100f
XE6  n_dl3 t3 vss vdd inv2
CDL6 t3    vss 100f
XE7  t3    n_dl4 vss vdd inv2
CDL7 n_dl4 vss 100f
XE8  n_dl4 t4 vss vdd inv2
CDL8 t4    vss 100f
XE9  t4    n_dl5 vss vdd inv2
CDL9 n_dl5 vss 100f
XE10 n_dl5 t5 vss vdd inv2
CDL10 t5   vss 100f

* ---------------- 3. comparator clock pulses -----------------------
* cki is high from tap i to tap i+1
XU2 t2 u2 vss vdd inv1
XU3 t3 u3 vss vdd inv1
XU4 t4 u4 vss vdd inv1
XU5 t5 u5 vss vdd inv1
XP1 t1 u2 np1 vss vdd nand2
XC1 np1 ckc3 vss vdd inv2
XP2 t2 u3 np2 vss vdd nand2
XC2 np2 ckc2 vss vdd inv2
XP3 t3 u4 np3 vss vdd nand2
XC3 np3 ckc1 vss vdd inv2
XP4 t4 u5 np4 vss vdd nand2
XC4 np4 ckc0 vss vdd inv2

* ---------------- 4. per-bit latches and CDAC drive ----------------
* ctrl = enable AND latch output (the precharged latch output provides
*        the "trial = 1" state, enable selects which bit is on trial)
* a    = nsmp AND  ctrl   -> N side vrefn switch / P side vrefp switch

taskTitle: Design a 4-Bit 100 MS/s Asynchronous SAR ADC
circuit:
* 4-bit 100 MS/s fully differential asynchronous SAR ADC, SKY130.
*
* Architecture
*   Top-plate sampling onto a 16C-per-side binary capacitive DAC.  During
*   acquisition every switchable bottom plate is shorted to one common
*   node, so the sampling reference is the charge-shared (vinp+vinn)/2 and
*   the comparator common mode stays at vdd/2 for the whole conversion.
*   Each decided bit drives the winning side's bottom plate to vrefp and
*   the losing side's to vrefn (Vcm-based monotonic switching), which
*   reproduces the thresholds 2*D-16 exactly.
*   Comparison is asynchronous: a fixed-delay tap chain yields four
*   non-overlapping slots, a two-stage dynamic comparator strobed by their
*   OR resolves each bit, and two NAND SR latches per bit hold the result
*   and drive the DAC bottom plates.  TG master/slave registers retime the
*   four bits onto the output pins on the sampling clock edge.

taskTitle: Design a 4-Bit 100 MS/s Asynchronous SAR ADC
circuit:
* 4-bit asynchronous SAR ADC, 100 MS/s, sky130 core CMOS + ideal capacitors
*
* Architecture (differential charge redistribution, input sampled on the CDAC top plates):
*   sampling  : CDAC bottom plates held at vrefn by the DAC drivers, top plates Tp/Tn
*               connected to vinp/vinn through CMOS transmission gates.
*   conversion: top plates float.  The driver for bottom plate of cap i goes to vrefp
*               on the P side when d_i = 0 and on the N side when d_i = 1, so
*               Vxp - Vxn = vid + (a_p - a_n)*VDD/16.  Every comparison therefore has
*               a margin of at least one LSB_se = VDD/16 and the top plates stay in
*               [0, VDD].  Complementary switching also makes the final common mode
*               of both top plates equal to VDD - LSB_se/2 for every code.
*   sequencer : inverter delay line tapped to make four self-timed comparison pulses
*               (3*Tinv wide, 3*Tinv apart, so the DAC and the comparator reset have
*               a full 3*Tinv of settling each).
*   output    : transparent latches strobed by a pulse derived from the clks rising
*               edge, so a code acquired in one period is valid 4.5 ns into the next.
*
.subckt sar_adc_4bit_async clks dout3 dout2 dout1 dout0 vss vdd vinn vinp vrefn vrefp

* ------------------------------------------------------------------ local cells
.subckt inv_s a y vp vn
XMp  y a vp vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XMn  y a vn vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
.ends inv_s

.subckt inv_m a y vp vn
XMp  y a vp vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
XMn  y a vn vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends inv_m

.subckt inv_b a y vp vn
XMp  y a vp vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
XMn  y a vn vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
.ends inv_b

.subckt inv_k a y vp vn
XMp  y a vp vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8.0 nf=4
XMn  y a vn vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=4
.ends inv_k

.subckt nand2_d a b y vp vn
XMp1 y a vp vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.0 nf=1
XMp2 y b vp vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.0 nf=1
XMn1 y a n1 vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.52 nf=1
XMn2 n1 b vn vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.52 nf=1
.ends nand2_d

.subckt nand4 a b c d y vp vn
XMp1 y a vp vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XMp2 y b vp vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XMp3 y c vp vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XMp4 y d vp vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XMn1 y a n1 vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XMn2 n1 b n2 vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XMn3 n2 c n3 vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XMn4 n3 d vn vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
.ends nand4

.subckt nor2 a b y vp vn
XMp1 n1 a vp vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XMp2 y b n1 vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XMn1 y a vn vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XMn2 y b vn vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
.ends nor2

* CMOS transmission gate: n1 <-> n2 conducting when c is high
.subckt tg n1 n2 c cb vp vn
XMN n1 c n2 vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8.0 nf=2
XMP n1 cb n2 vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8.0 nf=2
.ends tg

* tri-state inverter: y = NOT(a) when en is high, high impedance when en is low
.subckt tsinv a y en enb vp vn
XMP1 n1 enb vp vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
XMP2 y  a   n1 vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
XMN1 n2 a   vn vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XMN2 y  en  n2 vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
.ends tsinv

* =========================================================== clock buffer
* single inversion: ckb is high for the whole conversion window (clks low)
XCKB clks ckb vdd vss inv_k

* =========================================================== sequencer
* g0 = ckb, g(k+1) = NOT(g(k)).  Tap k makes one transition at k*Tinv.
* comparison strobe j is high on [ (6j+1)Tinv , (6j+4)Tinv ] : 3*Tinv to compare,
* 3*Tinv to precharge the comparator and let the CDAC settle.
XD0  ckb g1  vdd vss inv_s
CD1  g1  vss 8f
XD1  g1  g2  vdd vss inv_s
CD2  g2  vss 8f
XD2  g2  g3  vdd vss inv_s
CD3  g3  vss 8f

CD8  g8  vss 8f
XD8  g8  g9  vdd vss inv_s
CD9  g9  vss 8f
XD9  g9  g10 vdd vss inv_s
CD10 g10 vss 8f
XD10 g10 g11 vdd vss inv_s
CD11 g11 vss 8f
XD11 g11 g12 vdd vss inv_s
CD12 g12 vss 8f
XD12 g12 g13 vdd vss inv_s
CD13 g13 vss 8f
XD13 g13 g14 vdd vss inv_s
CD14 g14 vss 8f
XD14 g14 g15 vdd vss inv_s
CD15 g15 vss 8f
XD15 g15 g16 vdd vss inv_s
CD16 g16 vss 8f
XD16 g16 g17 vdd vss inv_s
CD17 g17 vss 8f
XD17 g17 g18 vdd vss inv_s
CD18 g18 vss 8f
XD18 g18 g19 vdd vss inv_s
CD19 g19 vss 8f
XD19 g19 g20 vdd vss inv_s
CD20 g20 vss 8f
XD20 g20 g21 vdd vss inv_s
CD21 g21 vss 8f
XD21 g21 g22 vdd vss inv_s
CD22 g22 vss 8f

XST0 g1  g4  st0 vdd vss nor2
XST1 g7  g10 st1 vdd vss nor2
XST2 g13 g16 st2 vdd vss nor2
XST3 g19 g22 st3 vdd vss nor2
XSB0 st0 st0b vdd vss inv_s
XSB1 st1 st1b vdd vss inv_s
XSB2 st2 st2b vdd vss inv_s
XSB3 st3 st3b vdd vss inv_s

* comparator clock = OR of the four strobes
XCKC st0b st1b st2b st3b ck vdd vss nand4
XCKCB ck ckb_cmp vdd vss inv_s

* =========================================================== comparator
* StrongARM latch.  Reset (ck low): fp=fn=vdd, outp=outn=0, so comp = outn = 0.
* ck high: the branch with the higher input gate voltage discharges first, so
* comp = outn = 1  <=>  Vxp > Vxn.  The cross-coupled NMOS are wider than the
* set PMOS so the latched state is not pulled back when the losing PMOS turns on.
XTAIL tn    ck      vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XINP  fp    Tp      tn  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XINN  fn    Tn      tn  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XPR1  fp    ck      vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XPR2  fn    ck      vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XSETP outp  fn      vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XSETN outn  fp      vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XCRP  outp  outn    vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.26 nf=1
XCRN  outn  outp    vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.26 nf=1
XRSP  outp  ckb_cmp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XRSN  outn  ckb_cmp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1

* =========================================================== SAR decision latches
* bit 3 <- strobe0, bit 2 <- strobe1, bit 1 <- strobe2, bit 0 <- strobe3
XLT3  outn n3  st0  st0b vdd vss tsinv
XLI3  n3   n3b vdd  vss  inv_b
XLF3  n3b  n3  st0b st0  vdd vss tsinv

XLB0b n0  d0b vdd  vss  inv_b

taskTitle: Design a 4-Bit 100 MS/s Asynchronous SAR ADC
circuit:
* 4-bit 100 MS/s fully differential asynchronous SAR ADC, SKY130.
*
* Architecture: top-plate sampling onto a split capacitive DAC.  Each bit has
* four unit capacitors (two per side) whose bottom plates rest on opposite
* rails, so every decision moves one capacitor down on one side and one up on
* the other.  The differential step is w_i*VDD while the common mode of the
* comparator inputs never moves, which keeps the dynamic comparator biased at
* VDD/2 for all 16 codes.
*
* Sequencing is fully asynchronous: a dynamic latch comparator resolves, its
* resolution pulse is stretched through an inverter delay line, and that
* strobes the SAR decision register and the one-hot token that advances the
* loop.  A NOR of clks, the delayed resolution pulse and the last token bit
* holds the comparator clock low during acquisition and after conversion.

* ============================ unit cells ============================
.subckt inv a y vdd vss
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends inv

.subckt inv2 a y vdd vss
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
.ends inv2

.subckt inv4 a y vdd vss
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36 nf=2
.ends inv4

.subckt invw a y vdd vss
* weak keeper inverter for static latch feedback
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
.ends invw

.subckt tgate a y c cb vdd vss
* a -> y while c=1 (cb is the complement of c)
XMN a c y vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XMP a cb y vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36 nf=2
.ends tgate

.subckt nand2 a b y vdd vss
XMN1 y a n1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XMN2 n1 b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XMP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XMP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends nand2

.subckt nand3 a b c y vdd vss
XMN1 y a n1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.26 nf=3
XMN2 n1 b n2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.26 nf=3
XMN3 n2 c vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.26 nf=3
XMP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XMP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XMP3 y c vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends nand3

.subckt nor3 a b c y vdd vss
XMN1 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XMN2 y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XMN3 y c vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XMP1 y a n1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.26 nf=3
XMP2 n1 b n2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.26 nf=3
XMP3 n2 c vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.26 nf=3
.ends nor3

.subckt dffr d ck ckb rst q qb vdd vss
* positive-edge DFF, asynchronous active-high reset (q -> 0)
* master n1 holds d while ck=0; slave n2 takes n1b while ck=1
Xm1 n1 d ckb ck vdd vss tgate
Xm1i n1 n1b vdd vss inv2
Xm2 n1b n1 vdd vss invw
Xs1 n2 n1b ck ckb vdd vss tgate
Xs2i n2 q vdd vss inv2
Xs3 q n2 vdd vss invw
Xrsb rst rstbi vdd vss inv
Xrs n2 rstbi vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36 nf=2
Xob1 n2 qnb vdd vss inv2
Xob2 qnb qb vdd vss inv2
.ends dffr

.subckt dffo d ck ckb q vdd vss
* positive-edge DFF with no reset; q is the only driver on its own node
Xm1 n1 d ckb ck vdd vss tgate
Xm1i n1 n1b vdd vss inv2
Xm2 n1b n1 vdd vss invw
Xs1 n2 n1b ck ckb vdd vss tgate
Xs2i n2 q vdd vss inv2
Xs3 q n2 vdd vss invw
.ends dffo

.subckt dsw bot c vrefn vrefp vdd vss
* bottom-plate selector: bot = vrefn while c=1, bot = vrefp while c=0
XMN bot c vrefn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=4
XMP bot c vrefp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8.0 nf=8
.ends dsw

.subckt samptg a y c cb vdd vss
* low-threshold transmission gate used for top-plate sampling
XMN a c y vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=2
XMP a cb y vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=4.0 nf=4
.ends samptg

.subckt comp inp inn clkc na nb vdd vss
* dynamic latch comparator, outputs pre-charged to vdd while clkc=0
* na falls first when inp > inn
Xpc1 na clkc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=4
Xpc2 nb clkc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=4
Xcp1 na nb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
Xcp2 nb na vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
Xin1 na inp ct vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=2
Xin2 nb inn ct vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=2
Xtl ct clkc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.0 nf=3
.ends comp

* ============================ ADC core ============================
.subckt sar_adc_4bit_async clks dout3 dout2 dout1 dout0 vss vdd vinn vinp vrefn vrefp

* ---- local clock inversion ----
XCKB clks clksb vdd vss inv2

* ---- top-plate sampling switches ----
XSMP vinp xp clks clksb vdd vss samptg
XSMN vinn xn clks clksb vdd vss samptg

* ---- split capacitive DAC, P side (top plate xp) ----
* PAi rests on vrefp and steps xp down; PBi rests on vrefn and steps xp up
CPA3 xp pa3 128f
CPB3 xp pb3 128f
CPA2 xp pa2 64f
CPB2 xp pb2 64f
CPA1 xp pa1 32f
CPB1 xp pb1 32f
CPA0 xp pa0 16f
CPB0 xp pb0 16f
CPFIX xp vrefp 32f

* ---- split capacitive DAC, N side (top plate xn) ----
CNA3 xn na3 128f
CNB3 xn nb3 128f
CNA2 xn na2 64f
CNB2 xn nb2 64f
CNA1 xn na1 32f
CNB1 xn nb1 32f
CNA0 xn na0 16f
CNB0 xn nb0 16f
CNFIX xn vrefp 32f

* ---- DAC bottom-plate switches ----
* PAi/NAi rest on vrefp; PBi/NBi rest on vrefn.  Bit=1 steps the P side down
* and the N side up; bit=0 does the reverse, so the differential moves by
* w_i*VDD while the top-plate common mode stays at VDD/2.
XSWPA3 pa3 a3 vrefn vrefp vdd vss dsw
XSWNA3 na3 z3 vrefn vrefp vdd vss dsw
XSWPB3 pb3 z3b vrefn vrefp vdd vss dsw
XSWNB3 nb3 b3 vrefn vrefp vdd vss dsw
XSWPA2 pa2 a2 vrefn vrefp vdd vss dsw
XSWNA2 na2 z2 vrefn vrefp vdd vss dsw
XSWPB2 pb2 z2b vrefn vrefp vdd vss dsw
XSWNB2 nb2 b2 vrefn vrefp vdd vss dsw
XSWPA1 pa1 a1 vrefn vrefp vdd vss dsw
XSWNA1 na1 z1 vrefn vrefp vdd vss dsw
XSWPB1 pb1 z1b vrefn vrefp vdd vss dsw
XSWNB1 nb1 b1 vrefn vrefp vdd vss dsw
XSWPA0 pa0 a0 vrefn vrefp vdd vss dsw
XSWNA0 na0 z0 vrefn vrefp vdd vss dsw
XSWPB0 pb0 z0b vrefn vrefp vdd vss dsw
XSWNB0 nb0 b0 vrefn vrefp vdd vss dsw

* ---- comparator and resolution detection ----
XCMP xp xn ckc cmpa cmpb vdd vss comp
XRES cmpa cmpb resn vdd vss nand2

* ---- resolution delay line: capture, token and comparator-stop taps ----
XRD1 rd1 resn vdd vss inv2
XRD2 rd2 rd1 vdd vss inv2
XRD3 rd3 rd2 vdd vss inv2
XRD4 resc rd3 vdd vss inv2
CRSC resc vss 60f
XRD5 rd5 resc vdd vss inv2
XRD6 rest rd5 vdd vss inv2
CRST rest vss 60f
XRDB restb rest vdd vss inv2
XRD7 rd7 rest vdd vss inv2
XRD8 resck rd7 vdd vss inv2
CRSK resck vss 60f

* ---- comparator clock: run while clks low, unresolved, token not spent ----
XCKC clks resck t4 ckc vdd vss nor3

* ---- one-hot token: Tn rises at the nth comparator resolution ----
XT1 clksb rest restb clks t1 t1b vdd vss dffr
XT2 t1 rest restb clks t2 t2b vdd vss dffr
XT3 t2 rest restb clks t3 t3b vdd vss dffr
XT4 t3 rest restb clks t4 t4b vdd vss dffr

* ---- SAR decision registers, one strobe per resolution ----
XCK3B resc t1b clksb ck3b vdd vss nand3
XCK3 ck3b ck3 vdd vss inv
XA3 cmpb ck3 ck3b clks a3 b3 vdd vss dffr
XZ3 cmpa ck3 ck3b clks z3 z3b vdd vss dffr
XCK2B resc t1 t2b ck2b vdd vss nand3
XCK2 ck2b ck2 vdd vss inv
XA2 cmpb ck2 ck2b clks a2 b2 vdd vss dffr
XZ2 cmpa ck2 ck2b clks z2 z2b vdd vss dffr
XCK1B resc t2 t3b ck1b vdd vss nand3
XCK1 ck1b ck1 vdd vss inv
XA1 cmpb ck1 ck1b clks a1 b1 vdd vss dffr
XZ1 cmpa ck1 ck1b clks z1 z1b vdd vss dffr
XCK0B resc t3 t4b ck0b vdd vss nand3
XCK0 ck0b ck0 vdd vss inv
XA0 cmpb ck0 ck0b clks a0 b0 vdd vss dffr
XZ0 cmpa ck0 ck0b clks z0 z0b vdd vss dffr

* ---- output register, clocked at end of conversion ----
XT4D1 t4 t4d1 vdd vss inv2
XT4D2 t4d1 t4d2 vdd vss inv2
XOD3 a3 t4d2 t4d1 dout3 vdd vss dffo
XOD2 a2 t4d2 t4d1 dout2 vdd vss dffo
XOD1 a1 t4d2 t4d1 dout1 vdd vss dffo

taskTitle: Design a 4-Bit 100 MS/s Asynchronous SAR ADC
circuit:
* 4-bit fully differential asynchronous SAR ADC (MOS + ideal capacitors only).
*
* Architecture:
*   - Top-plate sampling of vinp/vinn through transmission gates onto a
*     differential binary CDAC (8C,4C,2C switched + 2C fixed, C=25fF).
*   - Bottom plates sit at an internally generated VCM during acquisition and
*     are switched to vrefp/vrefn in complementary pairs per SAR decision.
*   - StrongARM comparator; decision valid = XOR(outp,outn).
*   - Self-timed loop: a falling-edge flag chain (f3,f2,f1,done) routes each
*     comparator decision into its bit latch; a rising-edge flag chain
*     (e3,e2,e1,donee) enables the CDAC switch pair right after each bit is
*     latched, so the CDAC settles while the comparator resets.
*   - Output registers capture the bit latches on the falling edge of clks.

.ends inv

taskTitle: Design a 4-Bit 100 MS/s Asynchronous SAR ADC
circuit:
* 4-bit Asynchronous SAR ADC - SKY130
* Architecture: bottom-plate sampling, binary-weighted CDAC, StrongARM comparator
* Asynchronous self-timed SAR controller with ring oscillator
*
* Timing: clks high = acquisition (2ns), clks falling = start conversion
* CDAC: differential binary-weighted (8C,4C,2C,1C) per side + 1C dummy
* All caps sampled with bottom plates at VREFN (0V)
* MSB trial: switch ALL caps (8C) on both sides to VREFP
* Subsequent bits: for bit k, switch cap based on previous bit result
*   - if previous bit=1: positive->VREFN, negative->VREFP
*   - if previous bit=0: positive->VREFP, negative->VREFN

* === Inverter ===
.subckt sar_inv in out vss vdd
XP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
XN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
.ends sar_inv

* === Buffer (2 inverters) ===
.subckt sar_buf in out vss vdd
XINV1 in mid vss vdd sar_inv
XINV2 mid out vss vdd sar_inv
.ends sar_buf

* === NAND2 ===
.subckt sar_nand2 a b out vss vdd
XP1 out a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
XP2 out b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
XN1 out a mid vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
XN2 mid b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
.ends sar_nand2

* === NOR2 ===
.subckt sar_nor2 a b out vss vdd
XP1 mid a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=4
XP2 out b mid vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=4
XN1 out a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XN2 out b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
.ends sar_nor2

* === AND2 = NAND + INV ===
.subckt sar_and2 a b out vss vdd
XNAND a b mid vss vdd sar_nand2
XINV mid out vss vdd sar_inv
.ends sar_and2

* === OR2 = NOR + INV ===
.subckt sar_or2 a b out vss vdd
XNOR a b mid vss vdd sar_nor2
XINV mid out vss vdd sar_inv
.ends sar_or2

* === XOR2 ===
.subckt sar_xor2 a b out vss vdd
XINV_A a an vss vdd sar_inv
XINV_B b bn vss vdd sar_inv
XNAND1 a bn n1 vss vdd sar_nand2
XNAND2 an b n2 vss vdd sar_nand2
XNAND3 n1 n2 out vss vdd sar_nand2
.ends sar_xor2

* === SR latch (NAND-based) ===
.subckt sar_srlatch s r q qn vss vdd
XNAND1 s qn q  vss vdd sar_nand2
XNAND2 r q  qn vss vdd sar_nand2
.ends sar_srlatch

* === StrongARM Dynamic Comparator ===
* clk high = evaluate, clk low = reset (precharge outputs to VDD)
.subckt sar_comp clk ip in op on vss vdd
* Tail current source (NMOS, gated by clk)
XN1 tail clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=4
* Differential input pair
XN2 ip  ip  tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.26 nf=3
XN3 in  in  tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.26 nf=3
* Cross-coupled PMOS latch (positive feedback)
XP1 op  ip  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=4
XP2 on  in  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=4
XP3 op  on  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=4
XP4 ip  op  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=4
* Precharge/reset NMOS (when clk low, pull outputs high)
XN4 op  clk vdd vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XN5 on  clk vdd vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
.ends sar_comp

* === Gated ring oscillator ===
* When en=1, oscillates; when en=0, output held low
.subckt sar_ringosc en out vss vdd
* Gated inverter: NAND + INV = AND(en, in) then invert
* Stage 1: NAND(en, fb) -> inv -> ck1
XNAND1 en fb n1 vss vdd sar_nand2
XINV1 n1 ck1 vss vdd sar_inv
* Stages 2-6: inverters for delay
XINV2 ck1 ck2 vss vdd sar_inv
XINV3 ck2 ck3 vss vdd sar_inv
XINV4 ck3 ck4 vss vdd sar_inv
XINV5 ck4 ck5 vss vdd sar_inv
XINV6 ck5 fb  vss vdd sar_inv
XINV7 fb  out vss vdd sar_inv
.ends sar_ringosc

* === Main SAR ADC ===
.subckt sar_adc_4bit_async clks dout3 dout2 dout1 dout0 vss vdd vinn vinp vrefn vrefp

.param cunit=50f

* ---------- SAMPLING SWITCHES ----------
* NMOS pass gates: conduct when clks=high (acquisition)
* Bottom-plate sampling: during acq, bottom plates connected to vrefn via these switches
* Top-plate sampling onto capacitors
XSW_P clks vinp tm_p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=5
XSW_N clks vinn tm_n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=5

* ---------- CDAC (positive side) ----------
* Binary weighted: 8C, 4C, 2C, 1C with 1C dummy
* Top plate node: tm_p
* During sampling: all bottom plates at vrefn via sampling switches
* During conversion: bottom plates switch to vrefp or vrefn per SAR bits

* Sampling caps (hold charge after switch opens)
* The sampling caps include parasitic + explicit cap on top plate
CP3 tm_p vss 8*{cunit}
CP2 tm_p vss 4*{cunit}
CP1 tm_p vss 2*{cunit}
CP0 tm_p vss 1*{cunit}
CPD tm_p vss 1*{cunit}

* CDAC switches - MSB (bit3) = 8C
* b3n=1 (VREFN side on) when bit3=0 OR during sampling
* b3p=1 (VREFP side on) when bit3=1 AND converting
* Use NMOS pass gates: gate=control, source=vrefx, drain=tm_p

* For MSB: always switch to VREFP during conversion (first trial)
* After decision: if bit3=1, keep at VREFP; if bit3=0, switch to VREFN
* Positive side: sw3p_on if converting AND (bit3 OR msb_trial_phase)
* Negative side: sw3n_on if converting AND (NOT bit3 OR msb_trial_phase)

* Actually let me simplify: use a dedicated switch per cap per ref
* sw_X_Y: connects cap X to ref Y when gate is high

* 8C positive side switches
XSW3P_P sw3p_en tm_p vrefp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
XSW3P_N sw3n_en tm_p vrefn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2

* 4C positive side switches
XSW2P_P sw2p_en tm_p vrefp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XSW2P_N sw2n_en tm_p vrefn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1

XSW1P_P sw1p_en tm_p vrefp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XSW1P_N sw1n_en tm_p vrefn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1

* 1C positive side switches
XSW0P_P sw0p_en tm_p vrefp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XSW0P_N sw0n_en tm_p vrefn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1

* ---------- CDAC (negative side) ----------
CN3 tm_n vss 8*{cunit}
CN2 tm_n vss 4*{cunit}
CN1 tm_n vss 2*{cunit}
CN0 tm_n vss 1*{cunit}
CND tm_n vss 1*{cunit}

* 8C negative side switches
XSW3N_P sw3n_en tm_n vrefp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
XSW3N_N sw3p_en tm_n vrefn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2

* 4C negative side switches
XSW2N_P sw2n_en tm_n vrefp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XSW2N_N sw2p_en tm_n vrefn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1

* 2C negative side switches
XSW1N_P sw1n_en tm_n vrefp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XSW1N_N sw1p_en tm_n vrefn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1

* 1C negative side switches
XSW0N_P sw0n_en tm_n vrefp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XSW0N_N sw0p_en tm_n vrefn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1

* ---------- COMPARATOR ----------
* Compares tm_p vs tm_n; op=1 means tm_p > tm_n (positive input wins)
XCOMP ck_comp tm_p tm_n op on vss vdd sar_comp

* ---------- ASYNC SAR LOGIC ----------
* clksb = inverted clks (high during conversion)
XINV_CLK clks clksb vss vdd sar_inv

* Ring oscillator: enabled when clksb=1 (i.e., clks low = conversion phase)
XRING clksb ck_int vss vdd sar_ringosc

* 4-stage one-hot shift register to track which bit is being decided
* sr3=active -> deciding bit3 (MSB), sr2->bit2, sr1->bit1, sr0->bit0
* Clocked by ck_int. Initialized: sr3=1 on clks falling edge
* After 4 cycles, all done (sr_all=0), ring osc can stop

* SR latches for shift register stages
* sr3: set when clks falls (start conversion), shifted out by sr2
* Use a D-FF approach: each stage captures the previous stage's output

* Simple approach: 4 D-latches in a ring, one preset to 1
* DFF: on rising edge of ck_int, Q follows D

* Let's use a simpler scheme: SR flip-flop chain
* sr3: S=clks_falling_edge, R=sr2_rising_edge
* sr2: S=sr3_rising_edge, R=sr1_rising_edge
* etc.

* Actually, simplest approach: 4 SR latches in a ring
* Each latch is set by the previous one and reset by the next one
* Bootstrap: sr3 is set by clks falling edge

* Generate clks falling edge pulse (one-shot)
* falling_pulse = clksb AND NOT clksb_delayed
XINV_F1 clksb clksb_d1 vss vdd sar_inv
XINV_F2 clksb_d1 clksb_d2 vss vdd sar_inv
XNAND_F clksb clksb_d2 fall_n vss vdd sar_nand2
XINV_F3 fall_n fall_pulse vss vdd sar_inv

* Generate clks rising edge pulse (for resetting after conversion)
XINV_R1 clks clks_d1 vss vdd sar_inv
XINV_R2 clks_d1 clks_d2 vss vdd sar_inv
XNAND_R clks clks_d2 rise_n vss vdd sar_nand2
XINV_R3 rise_n rise_pulse vss vdd sar_inv

* Shift register using SR latches
* sr3: set by fall_pulse, reset by ck_int when sr3 was active (i.e., after bit3 decided)
* sr2: set by ck_int when sr3 active, reset by ck_int when sr2 active
* sr1: set by ck_int when sr2 active, reset by ck_int when sr1 active
* sr0: set by ck_int when sr1 active, reset by ck_int when sr0 active

* Use a cleaner approach: D flip-flops clocked by ck_int
* D0=sr3 (ring), D1=sr0, D2=sr1, D3=sr2
* Initialize sr3=1, others=0 on fall_pulse

* NAND-based SR latch: S and R are active-low
* SR latch: Q = NAND(S, QN), QN = NAND(R, Q)

* Bit timing shift register
* 4 SR latches; each set by previous stage, reset by next stage
* sr3 -> sr2 -> sr1 -> sr0 -> (done)

* sr3: set by fall_pulse, reset when sr2 gets set
XS3 sr3_set sr3_rst sr3 sr3n vss vdd sar_srlatch
* sr2: set when sr3 active on ck_int rising, reset when sr1 gets set
XS2 sr2_set sr2_rst sr2 sr2n vss vdd sar_srlatch
* sr1: set when sr2 active on ck_int rising, reset when sr0 gets set
XS1 sr1_set sr1_rst sr1 sr1n vss vdd sar_srlatch
* sr0: set when sr1 active on ck_int rising, reset when done
XS0 sr0_set sr0_rst sr0 sr0n vss vdd sar_srlatch

* Set/reset logic for shift register
* sr3_set = fall_pulse (active low: NOT fall_pulse)
XINV_S3 fall_pulse sr3_set vss vdd sar_inv
* sr3_rst = ck_int rising while sr3 active -> NAND(sr3, ck_int_rising_edge)
* Actually: sr3 is reset when sr2 is set (which happens on next ck_int edge)
* sr3_rst = NOT sr2_set = sr2
XBUF_S3 sr2 sr3_rst vss vdd sar_buf

* sr2_set = ck_int AND sr3 (AND gate)
XAND_S2 ck_int sr3 sr2_set_raw vss vdd sar_and2
XINV_S2 sr2_set_raw sr2_set vss vdd sar_inv
* sr2_rst = NOT sr1_set = sr1
XBUF_S2 sr1 sr2_rst vss vdd sar_buf

* sr1_set = ck_int AND sr2
XAND_S1 ck_int sr2 sr1_set_raw vss vdd sar_and2
XINV_S1 sr1_set_raw sr1_set vss vdd sar_inv
* sr1_rst = NOT sr0_set = sr0
XBUF_S1 sr0 sr1_rst vss vdd sar_buf

* sr0_set = ck_int AND sr1
XAND_S0 ck_int sr1 sr0_set_raw vss vdd sar_and2
XINV_S0 sr0_set_raw sr0_set vss vdd sar_inv
* sr0_rst = rise_pulse (end of conversion)
XBUF_S0 rise_pulse sr0_rst vss vdd sar_buf

* ---------- BIT LATCHES ----------
* Each bit is set/reset based on comparator output during its time slot
* comp=op=1 means vinp > vinn (positive)
* For positive-side CDAC: if comp=1 (vinp>vinn), bit=1
*
* Bit latch: SR NAND latch
*   S = NOT(comp_p AND srX) = NAND(op, srX) -> active low set when comp says 1
*   R = NOT(comp_n AND srX) = NAND(on, srX) -> active low reset when comp says 0
* After conversion, latch holds until next clks rising edge resets it

* Bit 3 (MSB) latch
XB3_S op sr3 b3_set vss vdd sar_nand2
XB3_R on sr3 b3_rst vss vdd sar_nand2
XB3 b3_set b3_rst b3 b3n vss vdd sar_srlatch

* Bit 2 latch
XB2_S op sr2 b2_set vss vdd sar_nand2
XB2_R on sr2 b2_rst vss vdd sar_nand2
XB2 b2_set b2_rst b2 b2n vss vdd sar_srlatch

* Bit 1 latch
XB1_S op sr1 b1_set vss vdd sar_nand2
XB1_R on sr1 b1_rst vss vdd sar_nand2
XB1 b1_set b1_rst b1 b1n vss vdd sar_srlatch

* Bit 0 (LSB) latch
XB0_S op sr0 b0_set vss vdd sar_nand2
XB0_R on sr0 b0_rst vss vdd sar_nand2
XB0 b0_set b0_rst b0 b0n vss vdd sar_srlatch

* Reset latches at clks rising (start of new acquisition)
* Force both S and R low briefly... actually rise_pulse already handles sr0
* For b3,b2,b1: reset when their sr goes inactive (which is handled by the SR latch structure)
* The NAND SR latch holds its state when both inputs are 1 (inactive)
* When srX=0 (inactive), both bX_set and bX_rst = 1, latch holds
* When srX=1 (active), latch follows comparator

* But we need to reset at start of new conversion. Let's add explicit reset.
* Reset all bit latches on rise_pulse (clks rising edge)
* Force Q=0 by pulsing R input
XBR3 rise_pulse b3_rst_r vss vdd sar_or2
* Hmm this gets complex. Let's use a different approach.

* Actually the SR latch holds state between conversions because srX=0 makes both inputs 1.
* We need to clear the bits at the start of each new acquisition.
* Use clks rising edge to reset.

* Simpler: AND the reset with clks
* b3_rst_effective = b3_rst AND (NOT clks_rising_reset)
* Let's just force b3=0, b2=0, etc. when clks goes high

* Reset gate: when clks is high, force all bit outputs to 0
* This is just: dout = bX AND clksb
* (when clks=high, clksb=low, AND output=0; when clks=low, clksb=high, AND output=bX)

* ---------- OUTPUT GATES ----------
* Output = bit value AND clksb (0 during acquisition, bit value during conversion)
* Then buffer to output pins

XOUT3A b3 clksb b3_out vss vdd sar_and2
XOUT3B b3_out dout3 vss vdd sar_inv

XOUT2A b2 clksb b2_out vss vdd sar_and2
XOUT2B b2_out dout2 vss vdd sar_inv

XOUT1A b1 clksb b1_out vss vdd sar_and2
XOUT1B b1_out dout1 vss vdd sar_inv

XOUT0A b0 clksb b0_out vss vdd sar_and2
XOUT0B b0_out dout0 vss vdd sar_inv

* ---------- CDAC SWITCH CONTROL LOGIC ----------
* During sampling (clks=high): all caps bottom plates at VREFN
* During conversion: controlled by SAR bits
*
* swXp_en = cap X connected to VREFP when high
* swXn_en = cap X connected to VREFN when high
*
* For MSB cap (8C):
*   During sampling: sw3p_en=0, sw3n_en=1 (connected to VREFN)
*   MSB trial: sw3p_en=1, sw3n_en=0 (connected to VREFP)
*   After decision: if b3=1: sw3p_en=1, sw3n_en=0 (keep at VREFP)
*                   if b3=0: sw3p_en=0, sw3n_en=1 (switch to VREFN)
*
* Pattern: swXp_en = clksb AND (bX_prev = 1 OR trial_phase for this bit)
* where bX_prev = previous bit result that determines switching direction
*
* For the CDAC:
*   cap 8C: always VREFP during conversion (MSB always tests against VREFP on both sides)
*   cap 4C: if b3=1: pos->VREFN, neg->VREFP; if b3=0: pos->VREFP, neg->VREFN
*   cap 2C: if b2=1: pos->VREFN, neg->VREFP; if b2=0: pos->VREFP, neg->VREFN
*   cap 1C: if b1=1: pos->VREFN, neg->VREFP; if b1=0: pos->VREFP, neg->VREFN
*
* So for positive side:
*   sw3p_en = clksb (always VREFP during conversion)
*   sw3n_en = NOT clksb (always VREFN during sampling, off during conversion)
*   sw2p_en = clksb AND b3n (VREFP when b3=0)
*   sw2n_en = clksb AND b3  (VREFN when b3=1)
*   sw1p_en = clksb AND b2n (VREFP when b2=0)
*   sw1n_en = clksb AND b2  (VREFN when b2=1)
*   sw0p_en = clksb AND b1n (VREFP when b1=0)
*   sw0n_en = clksb AND b1  (VREFN when b1=1)
*
* For negative side (swapped):
*   sw3p_en for neg = sw3n_en for pos (opposite direction)
*   Actually I already connected them cross-wise in the instantiation above:
*   XSW3N_P uses sw3n_en, XSW3N_N uses sw3p_en

* Implement the switch enable signals
* sw3p_en = clksb (MSB always VREFP during conversion)
XBUF_SW3 clksb sw3p_en vss vdd sar_buf
* sw3n_en = sampling mode = clks (always VREFN during sampling)
XBUF_SW3N clks sw3n_en vss vdd sar_buf

* sw2p_en = clksb AND b3n
XAND_SW2P clksb b3n sw2p_en vss vdd sar_and2
* sw2n_en = clksb AND b3
XAND_SW2N clksb b3 sw2n_en vss vdd sar_and2

* sw1p_en = clksb AND b2n
XAND_SW1P clksb b2n sw1p_en vss vdd sar_and2
* sw1n_en = clksb AND b2
XAND_SW1N clksb b2 sw1n_en vss vdd sar_and2

* sw0p_en = clksb AND b1n
XAND_SW0P clksb b1n sw0p_en vss vdd sar_and2
* sw0n_en = clksb AND b1
XAND_SW0N clksb b1 sw0n_en vss vdd sar_and2

.ends sar_adc_4bit_async

* CDAC P-side (unit C=20fF, 16C/side=320fF)

XS3P vinp bp3 clks vdd vss nsw

XSBP vinp bpB clks vdd vss nsw
XB_B clks clks_bB vdd vss inv

* CDAC N-side (mirror: ctrl=1->Vrefn, ctrl=0->Vrefp)
* ============================================================

* Bit3 MSB: 8C=160fF
XS3N vinn bn3 clks vdd vss nsw
XV3N vrefn bn3 ce3 nce3 vdd vss tg
XG3N vrefp bn3 ceb3 nceb3 vdd vss tg
C3N tn bn3 160f

* Bit2: 4C=80fF
XS2N vinn bn2 clks vdd vss nsw
XV2N vrefn bn2 ce2 nce2 vdd vss tg

* Bit1: 2C=40fF

* StrongARM-type comparator: outn=1 when inp>inn, outp=1 when inn>inp

* input pair sets the initial polarity before regeneration takes over.

XEN2 pc2_b conv enn2 vdd vss and2

taskTitle: Design a 4-Bit 100 MS/s Asynchronous SAR ADC
circuit:
* 4-bit fully differential asynchronous SAR ADC, 100 MS/s.
* MOS + positive ideal capacitors only. Local parameter-free hierarchy.
*
* Top-plate sampling of vinp/vinn onto four matched hold caps per side while
* clks is high (2 ns).  The sampling switches open on the clks falling edge,
* so the post-acquisition decoy cannot disturb the held sample.
*
* Each bit trial charge-shares a fresh hold-cap copy with a complementary
* capacitive DAC (binary 8-4-2-1 + 1 dummy unit).  DAC tops are reset to
* vrefn between trials and the bottom plates are then steered to the trial
* code, so every trial sees a known threshold  T = (trial-8)*VREF/8.
* With Cs = Cd the share yields  (vdiff - T)/2  at a common mode of VDD/2.
*
* Self-timed bit windows open one trial at a time with a gap for comparator
* reset and DAC restore; the registered outputs are captured after the last
* trial and hold through the next acquisition.

*-----------------------------------------------------------------

*-----------------------------------------------------------------

Xdly1 clks c1 vss vdd invf
Xdly2 c1 clks_dly vss vdd invf
Xand_fp1 clks_n clks_dly fp_raw vss vdd and2
Xand_fp2 fp_raw en_n fall_pulse vss vdd and2

*-----------------------------------------------------------------
* Comparator and conversion enable
*-----------------------------------------------------------------
Xcomp P N en vss vdd sx sn comp
Xnand_cd sx sn comp_done vss vdd nand2
Xinv_cd comp_done cdn vss vdd inv
Xdly3 comp_done cdd1 vss vdd invf
Xdly4 cdd1 cdd2 vss vdd invf
Xand_cr2 cdn cdd2 cr2 vss vdd and2

Xinv_en1 e01 a01 vss vdd inv
Xnor_en2 s2 s3 e23 vss vdd nor2
Xinv_en2 e23 a23 vss vdd inv

Xtg_sp vinp P cs vss vdd tg
Xtg_sn vinn N cs vss vdd tg

* s0: set by fall_pulse; s{i+1}: set by delayed cr2 qualified by s{i}

*-----------------------------------------------------------------
Xand_p0 comp_done s0 p0 vss vdd and2
Xor_r0 p0 clks r0 vss vdd or2

Xand_u0 cr2 s0 u0 vss vdd and2
Xdly5 u0 du0 vss vdd invf
Xdly6 du0 du1 vss vdd invf

Xdlatch1 sn p2 b1 vss vdd dlatch
Xdlatch0 sn p3 b0 vss vdd dlatch

C1P P bp1 400f
C0P P bp0 200f

taskTitle: Design a 4-Bit 100 MS/s Asynchronous SAR ADC
circuit:
* 4-bit 100 MS/s fully differential asynchronous SAR ADC.
* Architecture:
*  - Transmission-gate top-plate sampling of vinp/vinn onto a fully
*    differential binary-weighted capacitor DAC (400/200/100/50 fF plus
*    a 50 fF dummy to vrefp per side).
*  - Monotonic charge-redistribution switching: during acquisition every
*    bottom plate is held at vrefp by a PMOS precharge switch; after each
*    decision the selected bit capacitor on the winning side is discharged
*    to vss through an NMOS switch.

*    capture pulse that registers the bit, steers the DAC switches, and a
*    fixed delay later retriggers the next comparison.
*  - Output bits are double buffered: the working SAR register is latched
*    to the pads on the clks falling edge, so the previous code is held
*    while the next conversion runs.

taskTitle: Design a 4-Bit 100 MS/s Asynchronous SAR ADC
circuit:
* 4-bit fully-differential asynchronous SAR ADC, 100 MS/s, SKY130.
*
* Architecture:
*  - Bottom-plate sampling: input TGs (clocked by clks, slightly delayed)
*    sample vinp/vinn onto the bottom plates of a binary-weighted
*    differential capacitor DAC (8C/4C/2C/C + dummy C per side, C=30fF).
*    Top plates are held on an internal VCM (diode divider) during
*    acquisition; the VCM switch opens first at the clks falling edge.
*  - Charge-redistribution search with only vrefp/vrefn:
*    each cap bottom plate sits at vrefn or vrefp during conversion.
*    State s_j=+1 -> p-side cap j at vrefp / n-side cap j at vrefn.
*    Trial states give exact binary thresholds:
*      MSB trial : s=(+,-,-,-,-)          -> D = -X
*      trial of bit j : s_i=2b_i-1 (i>j), s_j=+1, s_i=- (i<j), dummy=-
*    Comparator decides bit = 1 iff top_p < top_n (D<0).
*  - CMOS-input StrongArm latch comparator; self-timed 'done' signal
*    (NAND of the outputs) drives the asynchronous phase chain:
*    PH3->PH2->PH1->PH0, each phase: switch DAC, wait settle delay,
*    strobe comparator, latch decision, advance.
*  - Registered outputs: bit decisions latched by done pulses, final
*    output register clocked by the LSB done pulse.

* ---------------- primitive gates ----------------

XMMN y a vn vn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1

taskTitle: Design a 4-Bit 100 MS/s Asynchronous SAR ADC
circuit:
* ============================================================================
* 4-bit 100 MS/s fully differential asynchronous SAR ADC (SKY130 1.8 V core)
*
* Architecture
*   - Bottom-plate sampling: DAC top plates reset to an internal VDD/2 node
*     (vcm) while bottom plates track vinp/vinn. On the clks falling edge the
*     bottom-plate (input) switches open first; the top-plate switches open
*     ~150 ps later.
*   - Charge transfer: bottom plates are then switched to vcm, moving the top
*     plates to 2*vcm-vin, so the differential residual is vinn-vinp: the
*     comparator inputs are swapped accordingly and the sequence of decisions
*     directly forms the binary output code.
*   - Binary weighted CDAC, 8:4:2:1:1 per side (dummy cap never switches).
*     Decision D=1 moves the p-side cap bottom vcm->vrefp and the n-side cap
*     bottom vcm->vrefn; D=0 mirrors. Differential step (Ci/Ctot)*VDD with
*     comparator common mode near VDD/2. The LSB (bit 0) cap never toggles:
*     nothing follows the last decision.
*   - vcm = VDD/2 from a symmetric switched-capacitor divider (1p/1p) whose
*     midpoint charge is reset to zero every cycle, refreshed onto a 2p
*     storage capacitor during the acquisition phase.
*   - One StrongARM latch comparator and an asynchronous self-timed SAR
*     controller; each decision is captured in a latch before the comparator
*     precharges again.
* ============================================================================

* ------------------------- primitive building blocks -----------------------

.subckt s4_inv1 a y vd vs
XP1 y a vd vd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XN1 y a vs vs sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
.ends s4_inv1

.subckt s4_inv2 a y vd vs

.ends s4_inv2

.subckt s4_inv4 a y vd vs
XP1 y a vd vd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5.04 nf=6
XN1 y a vs vs sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.52 nf=3
.ends s4_inv4

.subckt s4_nand2 a b y vd vs
XP1 y a vd vd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XP2 y b vd vd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XN1 y a m1 vs sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
XN2 m1 b vs vs sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
.ends s4_nand2

.subckt s4_nor2 a b y vd vs
XP1 y a m1 vd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XP2 m1 b vd vd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2

* transmission gate, on for g=1 / gb=0
.subckt s4_tg1 a b g gb vd vs

.subckt s4_tg2 a b g gb vd vs

* transparent latch: passes d while ck=1, keeps otherwise; q and qb buffered
.subckt s4_dlatch d ck ckb q qb vd vs

.subckt s4_scmp inp inn clk outp outn done vd vs
XN0 cs clk vs vs sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.52 nf=3
XN1 x inp cs vs sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2

.ends s4_scmp

* switched-capacitor VDD/2 generator feeding the storage cap on vcm

* vsw : raise one outer plate to vdd, hold the other at vss, so the
*       midpoint floats to vdd/2 by symmetry, and share it onto vcm
.subckt s4_vcmgen mrst vsw vcm vd vs
CCG1 na nm 1p
CCG2 nm nb 1p
CCS vcm vs 2p
XNA na mrst vs vs sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.52 nf=3

XI1 vsw vswb vd vs s4_inv1
XPA na vswb vd vd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.52 nf=3
XNS nm vsw vcm vs sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XPS nm vswb vcm vd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.52 nf=3
.ends s4_vcmgen

.subckt sar_adc_4bit_async clks dout3 dout2 dout1 dout0 vss vdd vinn vinp vrefn vrefp
